```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-clone-mind
  name: Clone Mind (Complete DNA Extraction)
  version: 2.2.0
  description: Contract adapter for legacy phase-based clone mind workflow.
  type: orchestration
  state_machine:
    states: [init, brownfield-check, automated-source-acquisition, source-collection-validation, voice-dna-extraction, thinking-dna-extraction, synthesis-agent-block-generation, smoke-tests, quality-dashboard-generation, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: brownfield-check
      - trigger: brownfield_check_complete
        source: brownfield-check
        dest: automated-source-acquisition
      - trigger: brownfield_check_failed
        source: brownfield-check
        dest: failed
      - trigger: automated_source_acquisition_complete
        source: automated-source-acquisition
        dest: source-collection-validation
      - trigger: automated_source_acquisition_failed
        source: automated-source-acquisition
        dest: failed
      - trigger: source_collection_validation_complete
        source: source-collection-validation
        dest: voice-dna-extraction
      - trigger: source_collection_validation_failed
        source: source-collection-validation
        dest: failed
      - trigger: voice_dna_extraction_complete
        source: voice-dna-extraction
        dest: thinking-dna-extraction
      - trigger: voice_dna_extraction_failed
        source: voice-dna-extraction
        dest: failed
      - trigger: thinking_dna_extraction_complete
        source: thinking-dna-extraction
        dest: synthesis-agent-block-generation
      - trigger: thinking_dna_extraction_failed
        source: thinking-dna-extraction
        dest: failed
      - trigger: synthesis_complete
        source: synthesis-agent-block-generation
        dest: smoke-tests
      - trigger: synthesis_failed
        source: synthesis-agent-block-generation
        dest: failed
      - trigger: smoke_tests_complete
        source: smoke-tests
        dest: quality-dashboard-generation
      - trigger: smoke_tests_failed
        source: smoke-tests
        dest: failed
      - trigger: quality_dashboard_complete
        source: quality-dashboard-generation
        dest: complete
      - trigger: quality_dashboard_failed
        source: quality-dashboard-generation
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - step: brownfield-check
      id: brownfield-check
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Brownfield Check
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_brownfield-check
      outputs:
        - decision
      next: automated-source-acquisition
    - step: automated-source-acquisition
      id: automated-source-acquisition
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Automated Source Acquisition
      agent: aiox-master
      action: auto-acquire-sources-md
      task_ref: tasks/auto-acquire-sources.md
      outputs:
        - file
        - location
        - merge_with
      next: source-collection-validation
    - step: source-collection-validation
      id: source-collection-validation
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Source Collection & Validation
      agent: aiox-master
      action: collect-sources-md
      task_ref: tasks/collect-sources.md
      outputs:
        - file
        - location
        - required_for
      next: voice-dna-extraction
    - step: voice-dna-extraction
      id: voice-dna-extraction
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Voice DNA Extraction
      agent: aiox-master
      action: extract-voice-dna-md
      task_ref: tasks/extract-voice-dna.md
      outputs:
        - file
        - location
      next: thinking-dna-extraction
    - step: thinking-dna-extraction
      id: thinking-dna-extraction
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Thinking DNA Extraction
      agent: aiox-master
      action: extract-thinking-dna-md
      task_ref: tasks/extract-thinking-dna.md
      outputs:
        - file
        - location
      next: synthesis-agent-block-generation
    - step: synthesis-agent-block-generation
      id: synthesis-agent-block-generation
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Synthesis & Agent Block Generation
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_synthesis-agent-block-generation
      task_ref: tasks/clone-mind-synthesis.md
      outputs:
        - file
        - ready_for
      next: smoke-tests
    - step: smoke-tests
      id: smoke-tests
      phase: 7
      phase_name: Smoke Tests
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_smoke-tests
      task_ref: tasks/clone-mind-smoke-test.md
      outputs:
        - file
        - location
      next: quality-dashboard-generation
    - step: quality-dashboard-generation
      id: quality-dashboard-generation
      phase: 8
      phase_name: Quality Dashboard Generation
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_quality-dashboard-generation
      task_ref: tasks/clone-mind-quality-dashboard.md
      outputs:
        - file
        - location
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
workflow-id: wf-clone-mind
name: Clone Mind (Complete DNA Extraction)
version: 2.2.0
estimated-time: 2-3 hours
complexity: medium
description: |
  Executa extração completa do DNA de um expert para criação de agentes.
  Combina Voice DNA (comunicação/escrita) + Thinking DNA (frameworks/decisões).
specialists:
  primary:
    agent: "@oalanicolas"
    role: Mind Cloning Architect
    responsibilities:
      - Curadoria de fontes (ouro vs bronze)
      - Extração de Voice DNA + Thinking DNA
      - Validação de fidelidade (85-97%)
      - Diagnóstico de clone fraco
    invoke_for:
      - "Phase 0b: Source classification"
      - "Phase 1: Voice DNA extraction"
      - "Phase 2: Thinking DNA extraction"
      - "Phase 3: Synthesis validation"
      - "Phase 4: Smoke test review"
  process_validator:
    agent: "@pedro-valerio"
    role: Process Absolutist
    responsibilities:
      - Validar se workflow impede caminhos errados
      - Criar veto conditions em checkpoints
      - Identificar gaps de tempo
    invoke_for:
      - Quality gate validation
      - Checkpoint design review
inputs:
  required:
    - mind_name: Nome do expert a clonar
    - domain: Área de expertise
  optional:
    - sources_path: Caminho para fontes já coletadas
    - focus: "voice|thinking|both (default: both)"
    - auto_acquire: "true|false (default: true) - buscar fontes automaticamente"
    - mode: "greenfield|brownfield (default: greenfield)"
phases:
  - phase: -1
    name: Brownfield Check
    duration: 5 min
    skip_if: mode == 'greenfield'
    steps:
      - step: 1
        action: Verificar se mind já existe
        check: .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/{mind_slug}/mind_dna_complete.yaml exists?
      - step: 2
        action: Se existe, redirecionar para update-mind.md
        redirect_to: update-mind.md
        pass_inputs:
          - mind_slug
          - new_sources_path: sources_path
          - focus
    output:
      decision: greenfield|brownfield
  - phase: 0a
    name: Automated Source Acquisition
    duration: 15-30 min
    task: auto-acquire-sources.md
    skip_if: auto_acquire == false
    purpose: |
      Buscar automaticamente fontes na web antes de pedir materiais ao usuário.
      YouTube transcripts, book summaries, podcasts, artigos.
    tool_priority:
      "1": mcp-youtube-transcript
      "2": exa + WebFetch
      "3": WebSearch native
    fallback:
      on_tool_unavailable: Continue with next priority tool
      on_zero_sources: |
        WARN: Auto-acquisition found no sources.
        Continue to Phase 0b for manual collection.
      on_partial: Continue with available sources, flag gaps for Phase 0b
    output:
      file: acquired_sources.yaml
      location: .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/{mind_slug}/
      merge_with: collect-sources.md results
  - phase: 0b
    name: Source Collection & Validation
    duration: 30-60 min
    task: collect-sources.md
    blocking: true
    purpose: |
      "Single source = hypothesis; three sources = pattern"
      NUNCA extrair DNA sem validar fontes suficientes.
    steps:
      - step: 1
        action: Criar slug do mind
        output: mind_slug (snake_case)
        example: gary_halbert, dan_kennedy
      - step: 2
        action: Discovery - Pesquisa sistemática de fontes
        task: collect-sources-discover.md
        queries:
          - "\"{mind_name}\" books"
          - "\"{mind_name}\" interview transcript"
          - "\"{mind_name}\" podcast appearance"
          - "\"{mind_name}\" framework methodology"
      - step: 3
        action: Classificação por Tier
        task: collect-sources-classify.md
        specialist: "@oalanicolas"
        specialist_role: Classificar fontes em OURO vs BRONZE usando heurísticas de curadoria
        output: sources_by_tier.yaml
      - step: 4
        action: Validação de Cobertura
        task: collect-sources-validate.md + collect-sources-gap-analysis.md
        checks:
          - Mínimos atingidos?
          - Triangulação possível?
          - Gaps críticos?
      - step: 5
        action: GO/NO-GO Decision
        task: collect-sources-quality-gate.md
        output: sources_inventory.yaml
    checkpoint:
      gate: SOURCE_QUALITY
      blocking: true
      criteria:
        - 10+ fontes totais
        - 5+ fontes Tier 1 (primárias)
        - 3+ tipos diferentes de fonte
        - 5+ horas OU 200+ páginas de conteúdo
        - Framework principal triangulado (3+ fontes)
      decision_matrix:
        GO: 5/5 blocking checks passam → prosseguir
        CONDITIONAL: 4/5 blocking + plano de aquisição → prosseguir com flag
        NO_GO: <4/5 blocking → PARAR, pesquisar mais
      action_if_fail: |
        ❌ NO-GO: Não prosseguir para extração.
        → Executar plano de aquisição de fontes
        → Re-executar collect-sources.md
        → Só prosseguir quando atingir GO ou CONDITIONAL
    rework:
      retry_max: 2
      retry_actions:
        "1": Expand search queries, try alternative keywords
        "2": Request user materials, check obscure sources
      on_retry_fail: |
        ESCALATE: Source quality gate failed after 2 retries.
        → Present gap analysis to user
        → Request specific materials or confirm reduced fidelity
        → Document limitations in quality_dashboard
    output:
      file: sources_inventory.yaml
      location: .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/{mind_slug}/
      required_for:
        - Phase 1
        - Phase 2
  - phase: 1
    name: Voice DNA Extraction
    duration: 1.5-2 hours
    task: extract-voice-dna.md
    workflow: wf-extract-voice-dna.yaml
    skip_if: focus == 'thinking'
    specialist: "@oalanicolas"
    specialist_guidance: |
      Apply Playbook + Framework + Swipe File trinity.
      Extract: power_words, signature_phrases, storytelling patterns,
      anti-patterns, immune_system, contradictions.
    focus_areas:
      - Vocabulário (power words, frases assinatura)
      - Histórias & anedotas recorrentes
      - Estilo de escrita
      - Tom & dimensões de voz
      - Anti-patterns de comunicação (o que NUNCA dizem)
      - Immune system (rejeições automáticas)
      - Contradições de voz (paradoxos autênticos)
    output:
      file: voice_dna.yaml
      location: .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/{mind_slug}/
    checkpoint:
      gate: VOICE_QUALITY
      criteria:
        - 10+ power words
        - 5+ frases assinatura
        - 3+ histórias/anedotas
        - Dimensões de voz preenchidas
        - 3+ anti-patterns de comunicação
        - 2+ rejeições automáticas
        - 1+ paradoxo documentado
      score_minimum: 8/10
    rework:
      max_iterations: 3
      on_score_below_6:
        action: Re-analyze sources focusing on voice patterns
        specialist: "@oalanicolas"
        command: "*extract-voice-dna --deep-mode"
      on_iteration_fail: |
        ESCALATE: Voice DNA extraction below quality threshold.
        → Document gaps in voice coverage
        → Flag for user review of clone authenticity
        → Continue to Phase 2 with warning
  - phase: 2
    name: Thinking DNA Extraction
    duration: 1.5-2 hours
    task: extract-thinking-dna.md
    workflow: wf-extract-thinking-dna.yaml
    skip_if: focus == 'voice'
    specialist: "@oalanicolas"
    specialist_guidance: |
      Extract decision frameworks (SE/ENTÃO), heuristics, veto conditions.
      Map recognition_patterns, objection_handling, handoff_triggers.
    focus_areas:
      - Recognition patterns (o que notam PRIMEIRO)
      - Framework principal + secundários
      - Heurísticas de decisão
      - Arquitetura de decisão
      - Anti-patterns
      - Objection handling (como reagem a desafios)
      - Handoff triggers (quando delegam/param)
    output:
      file: thinking_dna.yaml
      location: .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/{mind_slug}/
    checkpoint:
      gate: THINKING_QUALITY
      criteria:
        - Framework principal com 3+ steps
        - 5+ heurísticas documentadas
        - Pipeline de decisão mapeado
        - 3+ anti-patterns
        - 2+ recognition patterns
        - 2+ objection responses
        - 1+ handoff trigger
      score_minimum: 7/9
    rework:
      max_iterations: 3
      on_score_below_5:
        action: Re-analyze sources focusing on decision frameworks
        specialist: "@oalanicolas"
        command: "*extract-thinking-dna --deep-mode"
      on_iteration_fail: |
        ESCALATE: Thinking DNA extraction below quality threshold.
        → Document gaps in framework coverage
        → Flag for user review of clone decision-making
        → Continue to Phase 3 with warning
  - phase: 3
    name: Synthesis & Agent Block Generation
    duration: 15 min
    steps:
      - step: 1
        action: Combinar Voice + Thinking DNA
      - step: 2
        action: Gerar bloco pronto para agent.md
      - step: 3
        action: Validar consistência entre voice e thinking
    output:
      file: mind_dna_complete.yaml
      ready_for: create-agent.md
    checkpoint:
      gate: SYNTHESIS_QUALITY
      criteria:
        - Voice e Thinking são consistentes
        - Sem contradições entre seções
        - Bloco YAML válido e completo
  - phase: 4
    name: Smoke Tests
    duration: 10 min
    blocking: true
    purpose: |
      "DNA extraído não significa nada se o agente não se comporta como o expert."
      Rodar 3 testes padronizados para validar comportamento real.
    checklist: squads/squad-creator/checklists/smoke-test-agent.md
    tests:
      - test: 1
        name: Conhecimento do Domínio
        prompt: Explique o conceito de {framework_principal} em suas próprias palavras.
        validates:
          - Usa power_words do DNA
          - Usa signature_phrases
          - Evita never_use words
          - Tom consistente com voice_dna
        pass_criteria: 4/5 checks
      - test: 2
        name: Tomada de Decisão
        prompt: "Estou diante de uma decisão: {cenário_do_domínio}. Devo fazer A ou B?"
        validates:
          - Aplica heurística documentada
          - Segue decision_pipeline
          - Usa framework para estruturar
          - Responde com convicção
        pass_criteria: 4/5 checks
      - test: 3
        name: Resposta a Objeção
        prompt: Discordo do seu método. {objeção_comum}. O que você tem a dizer?
        validates:
          - Reconhece a objeção
          - Usa objection_response do DNA
          - Mantém convicção
          - Parece resposta real do expert
        pass_criteria: 4/5 checks
    checkpoint:
      gate: SMOKE_TEST
      blocking: true
      criteria:
        - 3/3 tests passam
      action_if_fail: |
        ❌ SMOKE TEST FALHOU

        O agente não está se comportando como {mind_name}.

        Ações:
        1. Revisar seção que falhou no DNA
        2. Adicionar mais exemplos no agent.md
        3. Verificar se fontes eram suficientes
        4. Re-rodar smoke test após ajustes
    output:
      file: smoke_test_result.yaml
      location: .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/{mind_slug}/
  - phase: 5
    name: Quality Dashboard Generation
    duration: 5 min
    steps:
      - step: 1
        action: Calcular métricas de qualidade
        metrics:
          - sources_count
          - tier_1_ratio
          - voice_score
          - thinking_score
          - smoke_test_result
          - fidelity_estimate
      - step: 2
        action: Gerar quality dashboard usando template
        template: squads/squad-creator/templates/quality-dashboard-tmpl.md
      - step: 3
        action: Identificar gaps e recommendations
    output:
      file: quality_dashboard.md
      location: .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/{mind_slug}/
output_template: |
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # MIND DNA - {MIND_NAME}
  # Domain: {DOMAIN}
  # Extracted: {DATE}
  # Workflow: wf-clone-mind v1.0
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  mind_dna:
    metadata:
      name: "{mind_name}"
      slug: "{mind_slug}"
      domain: "{domain}"
      extraction_date: "{date}"
      sources_count: {n}
      fidelity_tier: "fast-clone"

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # VOICE DNA (from extract-voice-dna.md)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    voice_dna:
      identity_statement: ""

      vocabulary:
        power_words: []
        signature_phrases: []
        metaphors: []
        rules:
          always_use: []
          never_use: []

      storytelling:
        recurring_stories: []
        personal_anecdotes: []
        story_structure: {}

      writing_style:
        structure: {}
        rhetorical_devices: {}
        formatting: {}

      tone:
        dimensions: {}
        by_context: {}

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # THINKING DNA (from extract-thinking-dna.md)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    thinking_dna:
      primary_framework:
        name: ""
        purpose: ""
        steps: []
        when_to_use: ""
        when_NOT_to_use: ""

      secondary_frameworks: []

      diagnostic_framework:
        questions: []
        red_flags: []
        green_flags: []

      heuristics:
        decision: []
        veto: []
        prioritization: []

      decision_architecture:
        pipeline: []
        weights: []
        risk_profile: {}

      anti_patterns:
        never_do: []
        common_mistakes: []

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
execution:
  mode: sequential
  parallel_phases:
    - 1
    - 2
  commands:
    full: "*clone-mind {name} --domain {domain}"
    voice_only: "*clone-mind {name} --focus voice"
    thinking_only: "*clone-mind {name} --focus thinking"
    no_auto: "*clone-mind {name} --domain {domain} --auto-acquire false"
    update: "*update-mind {slug} --sources {path}"
  next_steps:
    - task: create-agent.md
      input: mind_dna_complete.yaml
  brownfield_commands:
    update: "*update-mind {slug}"
    update_with_sources: "*update-mind {slug} --sources {path}"
    update_voice_only: "*update-mind {slug} --focus voice"
quality_gates:
  - gate: SOURCE_QUALITY
    phase: 0b
    blocking: true
  - gate: VOICE_QUALITY
    phase: 1
    blocking: false
    score: 6/7
  - gate: THINKING_QUALITY
    phase: 2
    blocking: false
    score: 5/6
  - gate: SYNTHESIS_QUALITY
    phase: 3
    blocking: true
  - gate: SMOKE_TEST
    phase: 4
    blocking: true
    score: 3/3
overall_pass: All blocking gates PASS + (VOICE >= 6/7 OR THINKING >= 5/6) + SMOKE_TEST 3/3
```

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-clone-review
  name: Clone Review
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: >
    Complete review of an existing clone: sources, trinity, stages, fidelity.
    Equivalent to a general audit. Hybrid execution -- worker script 90% + agent
    interpretation 10%. MANDATORY PREFLIGHT via clone-review.sh.
  type: orchestration
  command: "*clone-review {clone_path}"
  state_machine:
    states: [init, source-trinity, stages-fidelity, report, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: source-trinity
      - trigger: source_trinity_complete
        source: source-trinity
        dest: stages-fidelity
      - trigger: source_trinity_failed
        source: source-trinity
        dest: failed
      - trigger: stages_fidelity_complete
        source: stages-fidelity
        dest: report
      - trigger: stages_fidelity_failed
        source: stages-fidelity
        dest: failed
      - trigger: report_complete
        source: report
        dest: complete
      - trigger: report_failed
        source: report
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - step: source-trinity
      id: source-trinity
      phase: 1
      phase_name: SOURCE & TRINITY
      agent: oalanicolas
      task_ref: tasks/an-clone-review-source-trinity.md
      action: execute_source_checkpoints_and_trinity_verification
      description: Source checkpoints (5 per source) + Trinity verification (15 checkpoints)
      inputs:
        - clone_path
        - preflight_yaml
      outputs:
        - source_quality_scores
        - trinity_scores
      next: stages-fidelity
    - step: stages-fidelity
      id: stages-fidelity
      phase: 2
      phase_name: STAGES & FIDELITY
      agent: oalanicolas
      task_ref: tasks/an-clone-review-stages-fidelity.md
      action: execute_stage_architecture_and_fidelity
      description: Stage architecture review (5 checkpoints) + quick fidelity check (5 checkpoints)
      inputs:
        - clone_path
        - preflight_yaml
      outputs:
        - stage_score
        - quick_fidelity_score
      next: report
    - step: report
      id: report
      phase: 3
      phase_name: REPORT
      agent: oalanicolas
      task_ref: tasks/an-clone-review-report.md
      action: execute_generate_consolidated_review_report
      description: Generate consolidated review report with verdicts and priority actions
      inputs:
        - source_quality_scores
        - trinity_scores
        - stage_score
        - quick_fidelity_score
      outputs:
        - clone_review_report
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  inputs:
    required:
      - name: clone_path
        type: string
        description: Path to the clone agent file
    optional:
      - name: sources_dir
        type: string
        description: Path to sources directory
  outputs:
    primary:
      - clone_review_report
```

workflow:
  id: wf-compare-outputs
  name: Compare Model Outputs
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: >
    Compare Opus baseline vs Haiku output across 4 evaluation dimensions to
    determine model qualification. Evaluator Independence -- Opus ONLY.
    NEVER use Haiku to evaluate Haiku.
  type: orchestration
  command: "*compare-outputs {task_name}"
  state_machine:
    states: [init, load-inputs, score-dimensions, generate-report, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: load-inputs
      - trigger: load_inputs_complete
        source: load-inputs
        dest: score-dimensions
      - trigger: load_inputs_failed
        source: load-inputs
        dest: failed
      - trigger: score_dimensions_complete
        source: score-dimensions
        dest: generate-report
      - trigger: score_dimensions_failed
        source: score-dimensions
        dest: failed
      - trigger: generate_report_complete
        source: generate-report
        dest: complete
      - trigger: generate_report_failed
        source: generate-report
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - step: load-inputs
      id: load-inputs
      phase: 1
      phase_name: LOAD INPUTS
      agent: oalanicolas
      task_ref: tasks/an-compare-outputs-load.md
      action: execute_load_and_extract_comparable_items
      description: Load Opus baseline and Haiku output, extract comparable items
      inputs:
        - task_name
        - opus_baseline
        - haiku_output
        - task_file
      outputs:
        - comparable_items
      next: score-dimensions
    - step: score-dimensions
      id: score-dimensions
      phase: 2
      phase_name: SCORE DIMENSIONS
      agent: oalanicolas
      task_ref: tasks/an-compare-outputs-score.md
      action: execute_score_4_evaluation_dimensions
      description: Score tier_match, score_variance, checkpoint_match, recommendation_quality
      inputs:
        - comparable_items
      outputs:
        - dimension_scores
      next: generate-report
    - step: generate-report
      id: generate-report
      phase: 3
      phase_name: GENERATE REPORT
      agent: oalanicolas
      task_ref: tasks/an-compare-outputs-report.md
      action: execute_generate_qualification_report
      description: Generate qualification report with QUALIFIED/CONDITIONAL/NOT_QUALIFIED
      inputs:
        - dimension_scores
        - comparable_items
      outputs:
        - qualification_report
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  inputs:
    required:
      - name: task_name
        type: string
        description: Task being evaluated
      - name: opus_baseline
        type: string
        description: Path to Opus output file
      - name: haiku_output
        type: string
        description: Path to Haiku output file
      - name: task_file
        type: string
        description: Original task definition
  outputs:
    primary:
      - qualification_report

## Referência: references/squad/workflows/wf-context-aware-create-squad.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-context-aware-create-squad
  name: Context-Aware Squad Creation
  version: 1.4.0
  purpose: Create squads using context detection, parallel discovery, and hard final gates
  description: Context-aware greenfield/resume orchestration with native PRD -> epic -> state -> resume routing for large squads.
  orchestrator: "@squad-chief"
  type: greenfield_or_resume
  state_machine:
    states: [init, discovery, persist-creation-plan, scope-gate, architecture, creation, creation-tasks, creation-workflows, optimization, integration, quality-gates, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: discovery
      - trigger: discovery_complete
        source: discovery
        dest: persist-creation-plan
      - trigger: discovery_failed
        source: discovery
        dest: failed
      - trigger: persist_creation_plan_complete
        source: persist-creation-plan
        dest: scope-gate
      - trigger: persist_creation_plan_failed
        source: persist-creation-plan
        dest: failed
      - trigger: scope_gate_complete
        source: scope-gate
        dest: architecture
      - trigger: scope_gate_failed
        source: scope-gate
        dest: failed
      - trigger: architecture_complete
        source: architecture
        dest: creation
      - trigger: architecture_failed
        source: architecture
        dest: failed
      - trigger: creation_complete
        source: creation
        dest: creation-tasks
      - trigger: creation_failed
        source: creation
        dest: failed
      - trigger: creation_tasks_complete
        source: creation-tasks
        dest: creation-workflows
      - trigger: creation_tasks_failed
        source: creation-tasks
        dest: failed
      - trigger: creation_workflows_complete
        source: creation-workflows
        dest: optimization
      - trigger: creation_workflows_failed
        source: creation-workflows
        dest: failed
      - trigger: optimization_complete
        source: optimization
        dest: integration
      - trigger: optimization_failed
        source: optimization
        dest: failed
      - trigger: integration_complete
        source: integration
        dest: quality-gates
      - trigger: integration_failed
        source: integration
        dest: failed
      - trigger: quality_gates_complete
        source: quality-gates
        dest: complete
      - trigger: quality_gates_failed
        source: quality-gates
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - import: modules/module-discovery.yaml
      agent: various
      action: import_module
    - phase: persist-creation-plan
      agent: "@squad-chief"
      task: create-squad
      task_ref: tasks/create-squad.md
      action: persist_creation_plan
      blocking: true
      notes: |
        NON-NEGOTIABLE: Persistir plano de criação com checklist completo
        ANTES de criar qualquer arquivo do squad. Aplica-se a TODOS os squads,
        independente do tamanho. Jamais confiar apenas na janela de contexto.
        Formato mínimo: creation-plan.yaml. Formato completo: prd.md.
        O plano DEVE listar TODOS os artefatos (agentes, tasks, workflows,
        checklists, templates, data, scripts) com [ ] checklist por item.
      outputs:
        - .aiox/squad-runtime/create-squad/{squad_name}/creation-plan.yaml
        - docs/projects/{squad_name}/prd.md
    - phase: scope-gate
      agent: "@squad-chief"
      task: create-squad
      task_ref: tasks/create-squad.md
      action: enforce_native_scope_gate
      notes: If total_artifacts >= 15 OR workflows_mapped >= 10 OR agents_needed >= 8, require docs/projects/{domain}/prd.md and epic-scoped execution with --epic=N before creation can proceed. The PRD must include alternatives compared, dependency stress test, and why-this-order rationale.
      outputs:
        - .aiox/squad-runtime/create-squad/{squad_name}/state.json
        - docs/projects/{squad_name}/epics/
    - phase: architecture
      agent: various
      task: create-squad
      task_ref: tasks/create-squad.md
      action: create_architecture
      notes: Use detected context, PRD, and merged discovery as mandatory inputs; compare at least 2 sequencing options, stress-test dependencies, persist why-this-order, then classify workspace integration level and contract
      outputs:
        - .aiox/squad-runtime/create-squad/{squad_name}/workspace-integration-level.yaml
        - .aiox/squad-runtime/create-squad/{squad_name}/architecture-decision-record.yaml
    - phase: creation
      agent: various
      task: create-agent
      task_ref: tasks/create-agent.md
      action: create_agents
    - phase: creation-tasks
      agent: various
      task: create-task
      task_ref: tasks/create-task.md
      action: create_tasks
    - phase: creation-workflows
      agent: various
      task: create-workflow
      task_ref: tasks/create-workflow.md
      action: create_workflows
    - phase: optimization
      agent: various
      task: optimize-workflow
      task_ref: tasks/optimize-workflow.md
      action: optimize_workflow
      notes: "Mandatory in greenfield: run optimization after workflow creation to eliminate ghost gaps and enforce executor/checkpoint quality before final gates"
    - import: modules/module-integration.yaml
      agent: various
      action: import_module
    - import: modules/module-quality-gates.yaml
      agent: various
      action: import_module
  checkpoints:
    - id: CP_CTX
      phase: discovery-context
      decision: CONTINUE_OR_CLARIFY
    - id: CP_SCOPE
      phase: scope-gate
      decision: PRD_OR_EPIC_GATE_SATISFIED
    - id: CP_ARCH
      phase: architecture
      decision: APPROVE_ARCHITECTURE
    - id: CP_WORKSPACE
      phase: architecture
      decision: WORKSPACE_CONTRACT_VALID
    - id: CP_OPT
      phase: optimization
      decision: OPTIMIZATION_APPLIED
    - id: CP_FINAL
      phase: quality-final-artifacts
      decision: PASS_OR_REVISE
  outputs:
    - squads/{squad_name}/
    - .claude/commands/{slash_prefix}/agents/{entry_agent}.md
    - .codex/skills/{entry_agent}/SKILL.md
    - .aiox/squad-runtime/create-squad/{squad_name}/state.json
    - .aiox/squad-runtime/create-squad/{squad_name}/workspace-integration-level.yaml
    - docs/projects/{squad_name}/epics/
    - .aiox/squad-runtime/optimize/{squad_name}/analysis-summary.yaml
    - .aiox/squad-runtime/create-squad/{squad_name}/creation-report.yaml
```

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-create-from-sop
  name: Create Squad Artifacts From Workspace SOPs
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: >
    Load canonical SOPs from workspace/businesses/{slug} and transform into
    squad creation artifacts. Business-aware operationalization with strict
    environment contract validation (full_workspace_mode required).
  type: orchestration
  command: "*create-from-sop --business={slug} --namespace={dir}"
  state_machine:
    states: [init, load-classify, map-workflow, generate-brief, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: load-classify
      - trigger: load_classify_complete
        source: load-classify
        dest: map-workflow
      - trigger: load_classify_failed
        source: load-classify
        dest: failed
      - trigger: map_workflow_complete
        source: map-workflow
        dest: generate-brief
      - trigger: map_workflow_failed
        source: map-workflow
        dest: failed
      - trigger: generate_brief_complete
        source: generate-brief
        dest: complete
      - trigger: generate_brief_failed
        source: generate-brief
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - step: load-classify
      id: load-classify
      phase: 1
      phase_name: LOAD & CLASSIFY
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/create-from-sop-load-classify.md
      action: execute_run_loader_validate_classify
      description: Run loader, validate environment contract, classify sources into 3 classes
      inputs:
        - business_slug
        - namespace
        - paths
      outputs:
        - classified_sources
      next: map-workflow
    - step: map-workflow
      id: map-workflow
      phase: 2
      phase_name: MAP & WORKFLOW
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/create-from-sop-map-workflow.md
      action: execute_extract_processes_and_synthesize
      description: Extract processes, synthesize workflows, surface gaps
      inputs:
        - classified_sources
      outputs:
        - task_inventory
        - workflow_map
        - open_questions
      next: generate-brief
    - step: generate-brief
      id: generate-brief
      phase: 3
      phase_name: GENERATE BRIEF
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/create-from-sop-brief.md
      action: execute_generate_creation_brief
      description: Generate creation brief with all artifacts for squad creation
      inputs:
        - classified_sources
        - task_inventory
        - workflow_map
        - open_questions
      outputs:
        - creation_brief
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  veto_conditions:
    - id: VETO-CFS-001
      trigger: Business slug not explicit
      action: BLOCK
    - id: VETO-CFS-002
      trigger: Environment contract not full_workspace_mode
      action: BLOCK
    - id: VETO-CFS-003
      trigger: Source of truth not workspace_canonical
      action: BLOCK
    - id: VETO-CFS-004
      trigger: No SOP selector defined
      action: BLOCK
    - id: VETO-CFS-005
      trigger: Selector resolves outside workspace/businesses/{slug}
      action: BLOCK
  inputs:
    required:
      - name: business_slug
        type: string
        description: Business identifier
      - name: namespace
        type: string
        description: SOP namespace directory
    optional:
      - name: paths
        type: array
        description: Specific SOP paths to load
  outputs:
    primary:
      - creation_brief
```

workflow:
  id: wf-create-pipeline
  name: Pro Pipeline Creation Router
  version: 1.0.0
  purpose: Route direct `*create-pipeline` invocations through the pro compatibility wrapper and delegate execution to the canonical base task.
  orchestrator: "@squad-chief"

      id: delegate
      agent: "@squad-chief"

      blocking: true
