## Referência: references/squad/workflows/wf-install-workspace-context.yaml

```yaml
# WF: Install Workspace Context
# Duration: 1-2 sessions
# Best for: Squads with workspace_integration.level >= controlled_runtime_consumer that need full context stack
# Key Agents: squad-chief
# Schema: Pattern A (workflow-yaml-schema v1.1.0)

workflow:
  id: wf-install-workspace-context
  name: "Install Workspace Context Stack"
  version: "1.2.0"
  orchestrator: "squad-chief"
  type: enhancement
  duration: "1-2 sessions"
  state_machine:
    states: [init, eligibility-audit, install-scripts, create-greeting, install-next-action, e2e-validation, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: eligibility-audit
      - trigger: eligibility_audit_complete
        source: eligibility-audit
        dest: install-scripts
      - trigger: eligibility_audit_failed
        source: eligibility-audit
        dest: failed
      - trigger: install_scripts_complete
        source: install-scripts
        dest: create-greeting
      - trigger: install_scripts_failed
        source: install-scripts
        dest: failed
      - trigger: create_greeting_complete
        source: create-greeting
        dest: install-next-action
      - trigger: create_greeting_failed
        source: create-greeting
        dest: failed
      - trigger: install_next_action_complete
        source: install-next-action
        dest: e2e-validation
      - trigger: install_next_action_failed
        source: install-next-action
        dest: failed
      - trigger: e2e_validation_complete
        source: e2e-validation
        dest: complete
      - trigger: e2e_validation_failed
        source: e2e-validation
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  description: |
    Instala o stack completo de contexto em um squad existente:
    context scripts + greeting determinístico + next action.

    Pipeline sequencial de 3 tasks existentes que, juntas,
    transformam um squad com greeting estático em um squad com
    contexto ativo, greeting determinístico e next action inferido.

    Este workflow NÃO faz parte do brownfield upgrade porque nem
    todo squad precisa de context stack. Aplicar cirurgicamente
    nos squads elegíveis (workspace_integration.level >= controlled_runtime_consumer).

    Produces:
    - 5 context scripts (runtime-paths, discover, set, load, show)
    - 1 greeting script determinístico
    - Next Action com heurística de gaps
    - Entry agent atualizado
    - Config atualizado

  best_for:
    - "Squads com workspace_integration.level >= controlled_runtime_consumer"
    - "Squads que precisam de greeting contextual com next action"
    - "Squads que consomem dados do workspace (business profiles, operations, products)"
    - "Pós-criação ou pós-upgrade de squads que interagem com workspace"

  eligibility:
    required_level: "controlled_runtime_consumer"
    check: |
      Ler config.yaml do squad alvo.
      Se workspace_integration.level < controlled_runtime_consumer:
        ABORT com mensagem: "Squad {name} tem level '{level}'. Context stack requer >= controlled_runtime_consumer."
    eligible_levels:
      - controlled_runtime_consumer
      - workspace_first
    ineligible_levels:
      - none
      - read_only

  decision_matrix_fit:
    awareness: "n/a"
    sophistication: "n/a"
    price_point: "n/a"
    traffic_temp: "n/a"
    primary_output: "Context-aware squad with deterministic greeting and next action"

  clone_combinations:
    primary: "squad-chief"
    secondary: []

# ===============================================================================
# EXECUTABLE SEQUENCE (canonical contract per workflow-yaml-schema v1.1.0)
# ===============================================================================
# Agent names MUST NOT use @ prefix.
# requires/next reference step IDs as strings.

  sequence:
    - step: "eligibility-audit"
      id: "eligibility-audit"
      phase: 1
      phase_name: "Eligibility & Audit"
      agent: squad-chief
      action: check_eligibility_and_audit
      task_ref: tasks/ics-audit.md
      description: |
        Verificar se o squad é elegível (workspace_integration.level) e
        auditar quais scripts já existem vs faltam. Mapear domínio do squad
        (entidades, paths canônicos, session schema).

        Fases 1-2 da task install-context-stack.md:
        - Ler config.yaml, extrair workspace_integration
        - Verificar eligibility gate (VETO-CS-001)
        - Inventariar scripts existentes vs faltantes (VETO-CS-002, VETO-CS-005)
        - Mapear domínio: primary_entity, session_schema, read/write paths
      outputs:
        - "audit-report (existing/missing/partial scripts)"
        - "domain-mapping (primary entity, session schema, read/write paths)"
      checkpoint:
        criteria:
          - "workspace_integration.level >= controlled_runtime_consumer"
          - "config.yaml parseável e entry_agent identificado"
          - "Audit report gerado com lista de scripts existentes vs faltantes"
          - "Domain mapping completo (primary_entity + session_schema definidos)"
        human_review: false
        message: "Eligibility check is deterministic. Auto-advance if all criteria pass."
      veto_conditions:
        - "Squad sem workspace_integration ou level < controlled_runtime_consumer -> ABORT (VETO-CS-001)"
        - "config.yaml não existe ou não parseável -> ABORT"
      next: "install-scripts"

    - step: "install-scripts"
      id: "install-scripts"
      phase: 2
      phase_name: "Install Context Stack"
      agent: squad-chief
      task: install-context-stack.md
      task_ref: tasks/install-context-stack.md
      description: |
        Gerar os 5 scripts de contexto que faltam, adaptados ao domínio do squad.
        Preservar scripts existentes. Integrar no config.yaml e entry agent.

        Fases 3-9 da task install-context-stack.md:
        - Gerar runtime-paths.cjs (namespace adaptado)
        - Gerar discover-context.cjs (entidades do domínio)
        - Gerar set-active-context.cjs (flags CLI do domínio)
        - Gerar load-context.cjs (enriquecer com workspace data)
        - Gerar show-context.cjs (formatação markdown)
        - Registrar scripts no config.yaml
        - Adicionar *show-context e *set-context no entry agent
        - Smoke test cada script (exit code 0)

        Referências canônicas: squads/aiox-copy/scripts/ (READ-ONLY)
      requires: "eligibility-audit"
      outputs:
        - "squads/{squad}/scripts/runtime-paths.cjs"
        - "squads/{squad}/scripts/discover-context.cjs"
        - "squads/{squad}/scripts/set-active-context.cjs"
        - "squads/{squad}/scripts/load-context.cjs"
        - "squads/{squad}/scripts/show-context.cjs"
        - "config.yaml atualizado com seção scripts"
        - "entry agent atualizado com *show-context e *set-context"
      checkpoint:
        criteria:
          - "Todos os 5 scripts existem em squads/{squad}/scripts/"
          - "Todos retornam exit code 0 com input válido"
          - "set-active-context cria session-context.yaml em .aiox/squad-runtime/"
          - "load-context retorna objeto com business_slug e readiness.status"
          - "show-context produz markdown legível"
          - "Nenhum script existente sobrescrito sem avaliação (VETO-CS-002)"
          - "Scripts 100% determinísticos, zero dependência LLM (VETO-CS-003)"
        human_review: true
        message: "Review generated scripts before proceeding to greeting creation."
      veto_conditions:
        - "Script existente sobrescrito sem backup -> BLOCK (VETO-CS-002)"
        - "Script gerado depende de LLM -> BLOCK (VETO-CS-003)"
        - "Script duplica funcionalidade existente -> BLOCK (VETO-CS-005)"
        - "Session context salvo fora de .aiox/squad-runtime/ -> BLOCK (VETO-CS-004)"
      next: "create-greeting"

    - step: "create-greeting"
      id: "create-greeting"
      phase: 3
      phase_name: "Create Greeting Script"
      agent: squad-chief
      task: create-greeting-script.md
      task_ref: tasks/create-greeting-script.md
      description: |
        Gerar o greeting determinístico (.cjs) que consome os context scripts
        instalados na fase anterior. O greeting mostra contexto ativo,
        comandos disponíveis e prepara o terreno para o Next Action.

        Seguir task canônica squads/squad-creator/tasks/create-greeting-script.md:
        - PHASE 1: Discovery (ler config, identificar context sources)
        - PHASE 2: Gap Map (definir sinais observáveis e prioridades)
        - PHASE 3: Generation (preencher squads/squad-creator/templates/greeting-script-tmpl.cjs)
        - PHASE 4: Integration (salvar script, atualizar agent STEP 3.5)
        - PHASE 5: Validation (executar script, verificar output)

        O greeting script DEVE importar load-context.cjs para dados contextuais.
      requires: "install-scripts"
      outputs:
        - "squads/{squad}/scripts/generate-{squad}-greeting.cjs"
        - "entry agent atualizado com STEP 3.5 (greeting script execution)"
      checkpoint:
        criteria:
          - "Script de greeting existe e executa sem erro (exit code 0)"
          - "Output contém bloco de Runtime Directives"
          - "Output contém seção de contexto ativo"
          - "Output contém tabela de comandos"
          - "Script importa load-context.cjs para dados contextuais"
          - "Entry agent tem STEP 3.5 referenciando greeting script"
        human_review: true
        message: "Review greeting output format and content before adding Next Action."
      veto_conditions:
        - "Greeting não importa load-context -> BLOCK (greeting sem dados)"
        - "Greeting hardcoda dados em vez de ler do contexto -> BLOCK"
        - "Script escrito sem carregar squads/squad-creator/templates/greeting-script-tmpl.cjs primeiro -> BLOCK"
      next: "install-next-action"

    - step: "install-next-action"
      id: "install-next-action"
      phase: 4
      phase_name: "Install Next Action"
      agent: squad-chief
      task: next-action.md
      task_ref: tasks/next-action.md
      action: apply
      flags: "--apply"
      description: |
        Adicionar heurística de Next Action no greeting script.
        Mapear gaps do squad, definir prioridades (blocking > non_blocking > intake),
        e adicionar CTA final determinístico.

        Seguir task next-action.md com --apply:
        - Fase 0: Discovery (mapear runtime, greeting, contratos de contexto)
        - Fase 1: Gap Map (signal -> severity -> next_action)
        - Fase 2: Implementation (inferNextAction, buildNextActionCallout)
        - Fase 3: Validation (teste automatizado cobrindo 3 cenários)

        Heurística obrigatória:
        - P1: Gap bloqueante (remediar) > P2: Gap estrutural (completar) > P3: Intake (operar)
        - Se blocker existe, NUNCA sugerir CTA genérico como *help ou *triage
      requires: "create-greeting"
      outputs:
        - "inferNextAction() adicionado ao greeting script"
        - "buildNextActionCallout() adicionado ao greeting script"
        - "Gap map documentado (signal -> severity -> next_action)"
        - "Teste automatizado cobrindo 3 cenários"
      checkpoint:
        criteria:
          - "Greeting termina com **Next Action:** `...`"
          - "Next Action inferido de gaps/contexto, não genérico"
          - "Gaps bloqueantes priorizados sobre comandos genéricos"
          - "inferNextAction() implementado no greeting script"
          - "Teste cobre: no context, blocking gap, ready state"
        human_review: true
        message: "Review Next Action heuristics and gap map before final validation."
      veto_conditions:
        - "Next Action usa CTA genérico quando blocker existe -> BLOCK (VETO-NA-003)"
        - "inferNextAction() não existe no greeting -> BLOCK (VETO-NA-001)"
        - "Sem teste automatizado -> BLOCK (VETO-NA-004)"
        - "Heurística sem fonte estrutural de contexto -> BLOCK (VETO-NA-002)"
      next: "e2e-validation"

    - step: "e2e-validation"
      id: "e2e-validation"
      phase: 5
      phase_name: "End-to-End Validation"
      agent: squad-chief
      action: validate_full_stack
      task_ref: tasks/ics-validation.md
      description: |
        Validação completa do stack instalado. Executar o greeting script
        e verificar que o fluxo inteiro funciona: context -> greeting -> next action.

        Testes end-to-end:
        1. Cenário "fresh start": nenhum contexto ativo
           - Expected: Next Action = bootstrap ou set-context
        2. Cenário "blocking gap": contexto ativo com gap crítico
           - Expected: Next Action = remediação do gap
        3. Cenário "ready state": contexto completo, tudo ok
           - Expected: Next Action = comando operacional principal

        Validar integridade completa:
        - 5 context scripts + 1 greeting script = 6 scripts total
        - Entry agent com *show-context, *set-context e STEP 3.5
        - config.yaml com seção scripts completa
        - Runtime Directives presentes no output
        - Next Action CTA presente no final do output
      requires: "install-next-action"
      outputs:
        - "validation-report.yaml"
      checkpoint:
        criteria:
          - "Greeting script executa sem erro (exit code 0)"
          - "Output contém: Runtime Directives + Context + Commands + Next Action"
          - "3 cenários de teste passam (no context, blocking, ready)"
          - "Entry agent activation-instructions referencia o greeting script"
          - "config.yaml tem todos os scripts registrados"
          - "Todos os veto conditions de todas as fases anteriores permanecem satisfeitos"
        human_review: true
        message: "Final review. If all checks pass, the squad is context-aware."
      veto_conditions:
        - "Qualquer smoke test falha -> BLOCK até correção"
        - "Output do greeting não contém Next Action -> BLOCK"

# ===============================================================================
# HANDOFF PROMPTS (phase-to-phase context passing)
# ===============================================================================

  handoff_prompts:
    eligibility_to_install:
      context: "Audit report com scripts existentes/faltantes e domain mapping"
      instruction: |
        Use o audit report para decidir quais scripts gerar.
        Preserve scripts existentes. Adapte ao domínio mapeado.
        O domain mapping define primary_entity e session_schema.

    install_to_greeting:
      context: "5 context scripts instalados e validados (smoke tests passed)"
      instruction: |
        O context stack está pronto. Gere o greeting script que IMPORTA
        load-context.cjs para dados contextuais. Use o template
        squads/squad-creator/templates/greeting-script-tmpl.cjs como base. Carregar template é obrigatório
        (template enforcement rule).

    greeting_to_next_action:
      context: "Greeting script funcional com contexto, sem Next Action"
      instruction: |
        O greeting mostra contexto mas ainda não tem Next Action.
        Aplique a task next-action com --apply para adicionar
        inferNextAction() e o CTA final. Use o gap map do domínio
        mapeado na Phase 1.

    next_action_to_validation:
      context: "Greeting completo com contexto + next action + testes"
      instruction: |
        Validação final. Execute o greeting script e verifique que
        o output completo está correto nos 3 cenários. Compare
        output contra o padrão dos squads aiox-copy e aiox-design.

# ===============================================================================
# SUPPLEMENTAL PHASE METADATA (optional, non-executable)
# ===============================================================================

  phases:
    - id: PHASE-1
      name: "Eligibility & Audit"
      days: "0.5"
      tier: 0
      description: |
        Fase de discovery e gate. Verifica elegibilidade do squad
        (workspace_integration.level >= controlled_runtime_consumer),
        audita o estado atual dos scripts de contexto, e mapeia
        o domínio do squad para adaptação dos scripts.

        Outputs: audit-report, domain-mapping
        Gate: VETO-CS-001 (ineligible squad)

      tasks:
        - task_file: install-context-stack.md
          agent: squad-chief
          required: true
          description: "Fases 1-2 da task: audit + domain mapping"
          output: "audit-report + domain-mapping"

      checkpoint:
        criteria:
          - "Level >= controlled_runtime_consumer"
          - "Scripts inventariados"
          - "Domain mapping completo"
        human_review: false
        message: "Eligibility is deterministic. Auto-advance."

    - id: PHASE-2
      name: "Install Context Stack"
      days: "0.5-1"
      tier: 1
      description: |
        Fase core. Gera os 5 scripts de contexto adaptados ao domínio
        do squad, preservando scripts existentes. Integra no config.yaml
        e entry agent. Executa smoke tests.

        Referências canônicas: squads/aiox-copy/scripts/
        Regras: self-contained, determinístico, importar não duplicar

      tasks:
        - task_file: install-context-stack.md
          agent: squad-chief
          required: true
          description: "Fases 3-9 da task: generate + integrate + validate"
          output: "5 scripts .cjs + config + agent atualizados"

      checkpoint:
        criteria:
          - "5 scripts existem e passam smoke test"
          - "config.yaml tem seção scripts"
          - "Entry agent tem *show-context e *set-context"
        human_review: true
        message: "Review scripts before greeting creation."

    - id: PHASE-3
      name: "Create Greeting Script"
      days: "0.5"
      tier: 1
      description: |
        Gera o greeting determinístico que consome o context stack.
        O greeting se torna o ponto de entrada visual do squad,
        mostrando contexto ativo e comandos disponíveis.

        Template obrigatório: squads/squad-creator/templates/greeting-script-tmpl.cjs
        Padrão: GREETING-CONTINUITY-001

      tasks:
        - task_file: squads/squad-creator/tasks/create-greeting-script.md
          agent: squad-chief
          required: true
          description: "5 fases: discovery, gap map, generation, integration, validation"
          output: "generate-{squad}-greeting.cjs + agent STEP 3.5"

      checkpoint:
        criteria:
          - "Greeting executa sem erro"
          - "Output contém Runtime Directives"
          - "Script importa load-context.cjs"
        human_review: true
        message: "Review greeting format before Next Action."

    - id: PHASE-4
      name: "Install Next Action"
      days: "0.5"
      tier: 2
      description: |
        Adiciona heurística de Next Action ao greeting.
        O squad agora sabe qual é o próximo passo e comunica
        isso ao usuário na ativação.

        Heurística: blocking > non_blocking > intake
        Padrão: GREETING-CONTINUITY-001

      tasks:
        - task_file: next-action.md
          agent: squad-chief
          required: true
          description: "3 fases: discovery, gap map, implementation + validation"
          output: "inferNextAction() + teste 3 cenários"

      checkpoint:
        criteria:
          - "Greeting termina com Next Action"
          - "Bloqueantes priorizados"
          - "3 cenários testados"
        human_review: true
        message: "Review heuristics before final validation."

    - id: PHASE-5
      name: "End-to-End Validation"
      days: "0.25"
      tier: 2
      description: |
        Validação final do stack completo. Todos os cenários
        testados, todos os scripts funcionais. Output comparado
        com padrão dos squads aiox-copy e aiox-design.

      tasks:
        - task_file: null
          agent: squad-chief
          required: true
          description: "Execução e2e do greeting + validação 3 cenários"
          output: "validation-report.yaml"

      checkpoint:
        criteria:
          - "Greeting completo (directives + context + commands + next action)"
          - "3 cenários passam"
          - "Todos os scripts funcionais"
        human_review: true
        message: "Final review. Squad is context-aware if all pass."

# ===============================================================================
# ERROR HANDLING
# ===============================================================================

  error_handling:
    on_phase_failure:
      - log_error: true
      - notify_stakeholders: false
      - create_remediation_task: false
      - halt_workflow: true

    on_checkpoint_failure:
      - log_failure_reason: true
      - return_to_previous_phase: true
      - max_retries: 2

    on_veto_triggered:
      - halt_immediately: true
      - escalate_to: "squad-chief"
      - document_reason: true

    specific_errors:
      ineligible_squad:
        detection: "workspace_integration.level is none or read_only"
        recovery: "ABORT workflow. Suggest simple greeting without context stack."
        prevention: "Check eligibility before workflow start."

      script_generation_fails:
        detection: "Script .cjs não executa (exit code != 0)"
        recovery: "Revisar código gerado, comparar com referência do aiox-copy."
        prevention: "Follow script structure contract from install-context-stack.md."

      session_context_not_created:
        detection: "set-active-context não cria session-context.yaml"
        recovery: "Verificar paths em runtime-paths.cjs e permissões de diretório."
        prevention: "Usar mkdir recursive antes de writeFileSync."

      readiness_resolver_missing:
        detection: "resolve-squad-workspace-readiness.cjs não encontrado"
        recovery: "Verificar se squads/aiox-workspace/scripts/ está acessível."
        prevention: "Validate precondition before starting workflow."

      greeting_template_missing:
        detection: "squads/squad-creator/templates/greeting-script-tmpl.cjs não encontrado"
        recovery: "Verificar se squads/squad-creator/templates/ está acessível."
        prevention: "Template enforcement: always Read() template before Write()."

      existing_script_overwrite:
        detection: "Script já existe e --force não foi usado"
        recovery: "Criar wrapper que importa o existente em vez de duplicar."
        prevention: "Always inventory before generating (Phase 1)."

# ===============================================================================
# COMPLETION SIGNALS
# ===============================================================================

  completion_signal: "<promise>COMPLETE</promise>"
  checkpoint_signal: "<promise>CHECKPOINT:PHASE-X</promise>"
  blocked_signal: "<promise>BLOCKED:PHASE-X</promise>"

# ===============================================================================
# OUTPUT ARTIFACTS
# ===============================================================================

  outputs:
    context_scripts:
      - "squads/{squad}/scripts/runtime-paths.cjs"
      - "squads/{squad}/scripts/discover-context.cjs"
      - "squads/{squad}/scripts/set-active-context.cjs"
      - "squads/{squad}/scripts/load-context.cjs"
      - "squads/{squad}/scripts/show-context.cjs"
    greeting_script:
      - "squads/{squad}/scripts/generate-{squad}-greeting.cjs"
    config:
      - "squads/{squad}/config.yaml (scripts section updated)"
    agents:
      - "squads/{squad}/agents/{entry_agent}.md (activation-instructions updated)"
    tests:
      - "squads/{squad}/scripts/test-context-stack.cjs"
    reports:
      - "validation-report.yaml (e2e test results)"

# ===============================================================================
# AGENT ASSIGNMENTS BY PHASE
# ===============================================================================

  agents_by_phase:
    PHASE-1:
      primary:
        - "squad-chief"
      secondary: []
    PHASE-2:
      primary:
        - "squad-chief"
      secondary: []
    PHASE-3:
      primary:
        - "squad-chief"
      secondary: []
    PHASE-4:
      primary:
        - "squad-chief"
      secondary: []
    PHASE-5:
      primary:
        - "squad-chief"
      secondary: []

# ===============================================================================
# QUALITY CHECKLIST
# ===============================================================================

  quality_checklist:
    eligibility:
      - "[ ] Squad config.yaml tem workspace_integration.level >= controlled_runtime_consumer"
      - "[ ] Entry agent identificado"
      - "[ ] Domain mapping completo (primary_entity + session_schema)"
    context_stack:
      - "[ ] 5 scripts existem em squads/{squad}/scripts/"
      - "[ ] Todos executam sem erro (exit code 0)"
      - "[ ] Scripts existentes preservados (não sobrescritos)"
      - "[ ] session-context.yaml criado em .aiox/squad-runtime/"
      - "[ ] load-context retorna business_slug + readiness"
      - "[ ] Scripts são 100% determinísticos (zero LLM)"
    greeting:
      - "[ ] Greeting script existe e executa sem erro"
      - "[ ] Output contém Runtime Directives"
      - "[ ] Greeting importa load-context.cjs"
      - "[ ] Entry agent tem STEP 3.5"
    next_action:
      - "[ ] inferNextAction() implementado"
      - "[ ] Greeting termina com **Next Action:** `...`"
      - "[ ] Blocking gaps priorizados sobre intake genérico"
      - "[ ] 3 cenários de teste passam"
    integration:
      - "[ ] config.yaml tem seção scripts atualizada"
      - "[ ] Entry agent tem *show-context e *set-context"
      - "[ ] Entry agent tem STEP 3.5 para greeting script"
      - "[ ] validation-report.yaml gerado"

# ===============================================================================
# GOVERNANCE GATE
# ===============================================================================

  governance_gate:
    protocol: "squads/squad-creator/protocols/ai-first-governance.md"
    required_checks:
      - "Existing scripts audited before generating new ones"
      - "Canonical references used (aiox-copy, aiox-design)"
      - "No script duplication (import existing, don't recreate)"
      - "All scripts deterministic (zero LLM dependency)"
      - "Template enforcement: squads/squad-creator/templates/greeting-script-tmpl.cjs loaded before Write()"

    ci_policy:
      blocking_deterministic_only: true
      deterministic_checks:
        - "script syntax (node --check)"
        - "exit code validation"
        - "session-context.yaml schema"
        - "Runtime Directives block present in greeting output"
      semantic_checks_enforced_in_workflow: true

# ===============================================================================
# CANDIDATE SQUADS (Known eligible — operational reference)
# ===============================================================================
# NOTE: This section documents known candidates for operational planning.
# squad-creator-pro is a meta-squad that operates ON squads, so listing
# specific squad names here is operational data, not a squad-agnosticism violation.

  candidate_squads:
    ready:
      - squad: aiox-sop
        level: controlled_runtime_consumer
        existing_scripts: ["load-workspace-context.cjs", "resolve-environment-contract.cjs"]
        domain: "SOPs por business, backlog prioritizado por wave"
        session_extras: ["sop_priority", "wave"]
      - squad: brand
        level: controlled_runtime_consumer
        existing_scripts: []
        domain: "Brand identity por business"
        session_extras: []
      - squad: movement
        level: controlled_runtime_consumer
        existing_scripts: []
        domain: "Movement intelligence por business"
        session_extras: []
    already_done:
      - squad: aiox-copy
        level: controlled_runtime_consumer
        notes: "Stack completo. Referência canônica."
      - squad: aiox-design
        level: controlled_runtime_consumer
        notes: "Stack completo. Referência canônica."
    ineligible_examples:
      - squad: cybersecurity
        level: none
        reason: "Não interage com workspace"
      - squad: storytelling
        level: read_only
        reason: "Leitura pontual, sem sessão ativa"
      - squad: deep-research
        level: none
        reason: "Não interage com workspace"

# ===============================================================================
# INLINE STRUCTURE: Context Script Architecture
# ===============================================================================
# Domain-specific guidance for the script generation phase.

  inline_structures:
    context_script_architecture:
      description: "Architecture pattern for the 5 context scripts"
      pattern: |
        runtime-paths.cjs (FOUNDATION)
            |
            v
        discover-context.cjs ──> set-active-context.cjs
            (list available)       (select + persist)
                                       |
                                       v
                               load-context.cjs
                               (read + enrich + readiness)
                                       |
                                       v
                               show-context.cjs
                               (format as markdown)
                                       |
                                       v
                               generate-{squad}-greeting.cjs
                               (consumes load-context + inferNextAction)

      dependency_chain:
        - "runtime-paths: imported by ALL other scripts"
        - "discover-context: standalone, uses runtime-paths"
        - "set-active-context: uses runtime-paths + resolve-squad-workspace-readiness"
        - "load-context: uses runtime-paths, reads session-context.yaml"
        - "show-context: uses load-context"
        - "greeting: uses load-context + inferNextAction heuristic"

    session_context_schema:
      description: "Minimal schema for session-context.yaml"
      pattern: |
        # Required fields (all squads)
        business_slug: "{slug}"
        set_at: "{ISO timestamp}"
        set_by: "set-active-context.cjs"

        # Optional fields (domain-specific)
        product_slug: "{slug or null}"
        campaign_slug: "{slug or null}"
        sop_priority: "{P0|P1|P2 or null}"
        design_system_slug: "{slug or null}"

        # Readiness (computed by set-active-context)
        readiness:
          status: "ready|not_ready|partial"
          reasons: []
          context_type: "{from config.yaml}"

# ===============================================================================
# METADATA
# ===============================================================================

  metadata:
    version: "1.0.0"
    framework: "AIOX Squad Creator Pro"
    created: "2026-03-19"
    primary_use_case: "Install full workspace context stack in eligible squads"
    key_difference: |
      Diferente do brownfield-upgrade que é genérico, este workflow é
      cirúrgico: só instala o context stack em squads elegíveis.
      Orquestra 3 tasks existentes (install-context-stack, create-greeting-script,
      next-action) em sequência com checkpoints entre cada fase.
      Não faz parte do upgrade padrão porque nem todo squad precisa.
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/wf-migrate-workflows.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-migrate-workflows
  name: Migrate Workflows to YAML
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: >
    Migrate legacy .md workflow files to standardized .yaml format. Ensures
    consistency, enables automated parsing, and supports schema validation.
    Three-phase: analyze, convert+validate, archive+cleanup.
  type: orchestration
  command: "*migrate-workflows {squad_name}"
  state_machine:
    states: [init, analyze, convert-validate, archive-cleanup, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: analyze
      - trigger: analyze_complete
        source: analyze
        dest: convert-validate
      - trigger: analyze_failed
        source: analyze
        dest: failed
      - trigger: convert_validate_complete
        source: convert-validate
        dest: archive-cleanup
      - trigger: convert_validate_failed
        source: convert-validate
        dest: failed
      - trigger: archive_cleanup_complete
        source: archive-cleanup
        dest: complete
      - trigger: archive_cleanup_failed
        source: archive-cleanup
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - step: analyze
      id: analyze
      phase: 1
      phase_name: ANALYZE
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/migrate-workflows-analyze.md
      action: execute_read_md_and_extract_structure
      description: Read .md workflows, extract structure, identify gaps vs YAML template
      inputs:
        - squad_name
      outputs:
        - workflow_inventory
        - structure_analysis
        - gap_report
      next: convert-validate
    - step: convert-validate
      id: convert-validate
      phase: 2
      phase_name: CONVERT & VALIDATE
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/migrate-workflows-convert.md
      action: execute_convert_to_yaml_and_validate
      description: Convert to YAML format, validate syntax and required fields
      inputs:
        - workflow_inventory
        - structure_analysis
      outputs:
        - converted_yamls
        - validation_results
      next: archive-cleanup
    - step: archive-cleanup
      id: archive-cleanup
      phase: 3
      phase_name: ARCHIVE & CLEANUP
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/migrate-workflows-archive.md
      action: execute_archive_originals_and_update_refs
      description: Archive original .md files, update cross-references, verify no broken links
      inputs:
        - converted_yamls
      outputs:
        - archived_files
        - updated_references
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  veto_conditions:
    - id: VETO-MWY-001
      trigger: Dry-run output not reviewed before conversion
      action: BLOCK
    - id: VETO-MWY-002
      trigger: Original .md files not archived before deletion
      action: BLOCK
    - id: VETO-MWY-003
      trigger: Cross-references not identified before archiving
      action: BLOCK
  inputs:
    required:
      - name: squad_name
        type: string
        description: Target squad with .md workflows to migrate
  outputs:
    primary:
      - converted_yamls
      - archived_files
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/wf-mind-research-loop.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-mind-research-loop
  name: Mind Research Loop
  version: 3.2.0
  description: Canonical mind-research orchestration led by @oalanicolas with process validation by @pedro-valerio.
  type: research
  state_machine:
    states: [init, source-collection, dna-extraction, process-validation, synthesis, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: source-collection
      - trigger: source_collection_complete
        source: source-collection
        dest: dna-extraction
      - trigger: source_collection_failed
        source: source-collection
        dest: failed
      - trigger: dna_extraction_complete
        source: dna-extraction
        dest: process-validation
      - trigger: dna_extraction_failed
        source: dna-extraction
        dest: failed
      - trigger: process_validation_complete
        source: process-validation
        dest: synthesis
      - trigger: process_validation_failed
        source: process-validation
        dest: failed
      - trigger: synthesis_complete
        source: synthesis
        dest: complete
      - trigger: synthesis_failed
        source: synthesis
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - phase: source-collection
      agent: oalanicolas
      action: collect_sources
      task_ref: tasks/collect-sources.md
      creates: mind_research_sources
    - phase: dna-extraction
      agent: oalanicolas
      action: extract_mind_dna
      task_ref: tasks/an-extract-dna.md
      creates: mind_research_dna
    - phase: process-validation
      agent: pedro-valerio
      action: validate_research_process
      task_ref: tasks/deep-research-validate.md
      creates: mind_research_quality_gate
    - phase: synthesis
      agent: oalanicolas
      action: synthesize_elite_minds
      task_ref: tasks/deep-research-execute.md
      creates: mind_research_report
  handoff_prompts:
    - from: oalanicolas
      to: pedro-valerio
      prompt: Review extracted DNA and evidence chain; block if process gates are weak or bypassable.
    - from: pedro-valerio
      to: oalanicolas
      prompt: Proceed only after process validation passes and finalize the elite-minds synthesis report.
workflow-id: wf-mind-research-loop
name: Mind Research Loop
version: 3.1.0
estimated-time: 15-30 minutes
complexity: medium
description: |
  Research and validate the world's best minds for any domain through
  iterative loop with self-criticism (devil's advocate).

  Core Philosophy:
  - People with skin in the game > Generic AI bots
  - Real consequences = Battle-tested frameworks
  - Clone elite minds = Guaranteed quality

  FUNDAMENTAL RULE:
  It doesn't matter if someone is "the best in the world" if there's
  no documented process we can replicate.
orchestrator: "@oalanicolas"
mode: YOLO
specialists:
  mind_cloning:
    agent: "@oalanicolas"
    role: Mind Cloning Architect
    responsibilities:
      - DNA extraction and source validation
      - Source quality classification (gold vs bronze)
    invoke_for:
      - "Phase: Source Collection"
      - "Phase: DNA Extraction"
  process_validation:
    agent: "@pedro-valerio"
    role: Process Absolutist
    responsibilities:
      - Workflow checkpoint validation
      - Quality gate design
    invoke_for:
      - "Phase: Workflow Checkpoints"
specialist_handoffs:
  - phase: Source Collection
    invoke: "@oalanicolas *assess-sources"
    workflow: "wf-assess-sources.yaml"
    context: Pass discovered sources for quality classification
  - phase: DNA Extraction
    invoke: "@oalanicolas *extract-dna"
    context: Pass validated sources + mind profile
  - phase: Workflow Checkpoints
    invoke: "@pedro-valerio *audit"
    context: Validate quality gates are properly blocking
frameworks:
  - id: tier-system-framework
    file: data/tier-system-framework.md
    usage: Classify minds by tier (Iteration 3, Final)
  - id: quality-dimensions-framework
    file: data/quality-dimensions-framework.md
    usage: Score each mind (Iteration 3)
  - id: decision-heuristics-framework
    file: data/decision-heuristics-framework.md
    usage: Cut/Keep heuristics (Iteration 2, 3)
inputs:
  - name: domain
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Area of expertise
    examples:
      - copywriting
      - tax-law
      - hr
  - name: context
    type: string
    required: false
    description: Additional context
    examples:
      - for Brazilian startups
  - name: must_include_local
    type: boolean
    required: false
    default: false
    description: Include local/regional minds
  - name: specific_needs
    type: array
    required: false
    description: Specific needs within domain
    examples:
      - - contracts
        - tax
outputs:
  primary:
    - name: mind_research_report
      format: markdown
      path: .aiox/squad-runtime/research/mind_research/{domain}/05-final-report.md
      description: Complete research report with curated minds
  artifacts:
    - Initial mapping (15-20 names)
    - Devil's advocate refinement (10-12 names)
    - Framework validation (6-8 names)
    - Final elite list (3-5 names with tier assignments)
  phase_artifacts:
    base_dir: .aiox/squad-runtime/research/mind_research/{domain}
    files:
      - 01-broad-research.md
      - 02-devils-advocate.md
      - 03-framework-validation.md
      - 04-cross-reference.md
      - 05-final-report.md
teams_execution:
  architecture: team_with_phase_dependencies
  owner: "@oalanicolas"
  phase_dependencies:
    - phase: ITERATION-2
      depends_on: ITERATION-1
    - phase: ITERATION-3
      depends_on: ITERATION-2
    - phase: ITERATION-4
      depends_on: ITERATION-3
    - phase: ITERATION-5
      depends_on: ITERATION-4
  phase_3_parallel_validation:
    enabled: true
    max_parallel_agents: 4
    strategy: batch_4_then_wait_all
    preferred_model: haiku
    notes:
      - Spawn at most 4 validation workers in parallel.
      - Wait for all workers in the current batch before next batch.
phase_handoff_contract:
  transport: file_artifacts
  artifact_root: .aiox/squad-runtime/research/mind_research/{domain}
  required_reads:
    ITERATION-2:
      - 01-broad-research.md
    ITERATION-3:
      - 02-devils-advocate.md
    ITERATION-4:
      - 01-broad-research.md
      - 02-devils-advocate.md
      - 03-framework-validation.md
    ITERATION-5:
      - 01-broad-research.md
      - 02-devils-advocate.md
      - 03-framework-validation.md
      - 04-cross-reference.md (optional)
  rule: Phases exchange state via files, never via transient chat memory.
phases:
  - id: ITERATION-1
    name: Broad Research
    tier: 0
    mandatory: true
    description: |
      Map the universe of experts in the domain.
      Generate initial list of 15-20 names.
    research_queries:
      - best {domain} experts thought leaders
      - top {domain} consultants frameworks
      - most influential {domain} professionals
      - "{domain} methodology creators founders"
      - best {domain} books authors
      - best {domain} Brazil specialists
      - "{domain} Brazilian reference experts"
    extract_per_result:
      - name: Expert name
      - title: Known title/position
      - known_for: What they're known for
      - has_framework: Has own framework/methodology? (yes/no/unknown)
      - sources_found: Which sources mention this person
    output_format: |
      ## Iteration 1: Initial Mapping

      ### Broad List (15-20 names)
      | # | Name | Known for | Framework? | Sources |
      |---|------|-----------|------------|---------|
      | 1 | Expert A | X methodology | Yes | 5 sources |
      ...

      ### Observations
      - {patterns identified}
      - {gaps in research}
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - At least 15 names identified
        - Each name has sources documented
      human_review: false
  - id: ITERATION-2
    name: Devil's Advocate
    tier: 1
    mandatory: true
    description: |
      Question your own research, find who's missing.
      Apply self-criticism to refine to 10-12 names.
    research_queries:
      - critics of {expert_names} methodology
      - alternatives to {popular_framework}
      - "{domain} contrarian experts different approach"
      - underrated {domain} experts hidden gems
      - who disagrees with {top_expert} {domain}
      - "{domain} experts not famous but effective"
    self_questioning:
      - Why {Expert A} and not {Expert B}?
      - Who would criticize this list? Why?
      - Who are the contrarians in {domain}?
      - Who is doing innovative work but isn't famous yet?
      - Is the list too American/Eurocentric?
      - Is any niche underrepresented?
    heuristic:
      id: SC_DA_001
      name: Devil's Advocate Cut/Keep
      from_framework: decision-heuristics-framework
      weights:
        source_mentions: 0.8
        original_work: 0.9
        practical_results: 0.9
        framework_documented: 1
      thresholds:
        source_mentions: 3
        original_work: true
        practical_results: true
      veto_conditions:
        - condition: source_mentions < 2
          action: CUT - Insufficient validation
        - condition: is_only_influencer = true
          action: CUT - No deep work
        - condition: no_practical_results = true
          action: CUT - Theory only
      decision_tree: |
        IF sources < 2 → CUT (insufficient validation)
        ELSE IF is_popularizer_only → CUT (no original work)
        ELSE IF no_practical_evidence → REVIEW (needs more research)
        ELSE → KEEP (proceed to Iteration 3)
    cut_criteria:
      keep_if:
        - Mentioned in multiple sources (>=3)
        - Has original work (not just a popularizer)
        - Active practitioner (not just theorist)
      cut_if:
        - Only appears in 1 source
        - Is just an 'influencer' without deep work
        - No evidence of practical results
    output_format: |
      ## Iteration 2: Devil's Advocate

      ### Names Added (weren't in initial list)
      | Name | Why they were missing | Relevance |

      ### Names Questioned
      | Name | Questioning | Decision |

      ### Refined List (10-12 names)
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Self-questioning applied to all names
        - At least 2 names added from devil's advocate
        - Refined to 10-12 names with justifications
      human_review: false
  - id: ITERATION-3
    name: Framework Validation
    tier: 2
    mandatory: true
    description: |
      Ensure each name has REPLICABLE DOCUMENTATION.
      Apply quality dimensions and tier classification.
      Refine to 6-8 names.
    frameworks_applied:
      - quality-dimensions-framework.md
      - tier-system-framework.md
      - decision-heuristics-framework.md
    quality_dimensions:
      accuracy:
        weight: 1
        threshold: 7
        veto_power: true
        check: Are their claims verified by results/case studies?
      coherence:
        weight: 0.9
        threshold: 6
        check: Is their methodology internally consistent?
      operational_excellence:
        weight: 0.9
        threshold: 6
        check: Is the process documented and replicable?
      innovation_capacity:
        weight: 0.7
        threshold: 5
        check: Did they create original frameworks?
      stakeholder_value:
        weight: 0.8
        threshold: 6
        check: Do they deliver proven results?
      scoring:
        method: weighted_average
        pass_threshold: 7
        per_dimension_min: 5
    tier_classification:
      tier_0_diagnosis:
        indicators:
          - Creates diagnostic/audit frameworks
          - Establishes baseline before action
          - Analytical focus
        examples: Auditors, analysts, diagnosticians
      tier_1_masters:
        indicators:
          - Proven track record ($XXM+ results)
          - Original methodology
          - Deep expertise, not just popular
        examples: Domain masters with documented results
      tier_2_systematizers:
        indicators:
          - Creates teachable frameworks
          - Process-oriented thinking
          - Methodology developers
        examples: Framework creators, educators
      tier_3_specialists:
        indicators:
          - Format/channel specific expertise
          - Applied specialization
        examples: VSL specialist, email specialist
    mandatory_criteria:
      must_have_all:
        - framework_documented: Has methodology/framework with own name?
        - process_extractable: Is there a documented step-by-step process?
        - artifacts_available: Has extractable templates, checklists, frameworks?
        - examples_exist: Are there application examples?
        - material_accessible: Is the material accessible (books, courses, articles)?
    validation_queries:
      - "{expert_name} methodology framework"
      - "{expert_name} process step by step"
      - "{expert_name} book template checklist"
      - "{expert_name} case study results"
    heuristic:
      id: SC_FV_001
      name: Framework Validation Gate
      from_framework: decision-heuristics-framework
      weights:
        framework_documented: 1
        process_extractable: 0.9
        artifacts_available: 0.8
        examples_exist: 0.8
        material_accessible: 0.7
      veto_conditions:
        - condition: framework_documented < 2
          action: VETO - No replicable methodology
        - condition: total_score < 10
          action: VETO - Insufficient documentation
      decision_tree: |
        IF framework_documented == 0 → VETO (no methodology)
        ELSE IF total_score < 10 → VETO (insufficient docs)
        ELSE IF total_score >= 12 → APPROVE (excellent)
        ELSE → APPROVE (acceptable)
    scoring:
      framework_documented: 0-3 (0=no, 1=partial, 2=yes, 3=excellent)
      process_extractable: 0-3
      artifacts_available: 0-3
      examples_exist: 0-3
      material_accessible: 0-3
      minimum_total: 10/15
      ideal_total: 12+/15
    output_format: |
      ## Iteration 3: Framework Validation

      ### Detailed Assessment
      | Expert | Framework | Process | Artifacts | Examples | Access | TOTAL | Tier | Status |
      |--------|-----------|---------|-----------|----------|--------|-------|------|--------|

      ### Tier Distribution
      - Tier 0 (Diagnosis): {names}
      - Tier 1 (Masters): {names}
      - Tier 2 (Systematizers): {names}

      ### Cut Due to Lack of Documentation
      | Expert | Reason | Veto Condition |
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Each mind scored against quality dimensions
        - Each passing mind assigned to tier
        - Refined to 6-8 names
        - Tier 0 has at least 1 mind (diagnostic)
      human_review: false
  - id: ITERATION-4
    name: Cross-Reference
    tier: 2
    mandatory: false
    condition: Still more than 6 names or doubts remain
    description: |
      Validate through multiple perspectives.
      Verify reputation and check for obvious omissions.
    cross_checks:
      - Appears in 'best of' lists from multiple sources?
      - Cited by other domain experts?
      - Has verifiable track record?
      - Results are verifiable?
    final_questions:
      - Did we miss anyone obvious that any domain expert would mention?
      - Does the list cover different approaches/schools in the domain?
      - Is there sufficient diversity (geographic, approach)?
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Cross-reference validation complete
        - No obvious omissions
      human_review: false
  - id: ITERATION-5
    name: Final Elite
    tier: 3
    mandatory: false
    condition: Still more than 5 names
    description: |
      Select the final team based on material availability.
      Apply tiebreakers if needed.
    tiebreakers:
      - Who has the most documented material?
      - Who has the most recent success cases?
      - Who has the most complete framework?
      - Who best complements others on the list?
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Final elite list of 3-5 minds
        - Each mind has tier assignment
        - Documentation available for each
      human_review: true
      message: |
        Please review the final elite list.
        These are the minds that will be cloned for the squad.
hard_veto_conditions:
  phase_1:
    - id: P1_V01
      condition: minds_count < 15
      action: VETO - Cannot proceed to Iteration 2
      severity: critical
    - id: P1_V02
      condition: any_mind.sources_found < 3
      action: FLAG - Needs additional source validation
      severity: warning
  phase_2:
    - id: P2_V01
      condition: self_questioning_answers < 5
      action: VETO - Devil's advocate incomplete
      severity: critical
    - id: P2_V02
      condition: new_minds_added == 0
      action: WARN - Review research breadth
      severity: warning
    - id: P2_V03
      condition: refined_count < 8 OR refined_count > 12
      action: VETO - Invalid refinement range
      severity: critical
  phase_3:
    - id: P3_V01
      condition: any_mind.total_score < 10
      action: CUT - Fails documentation threshold
      severity: critical
    - id: P3_V02
      condition: any_mind.framework_documented < 2
      action: CUT - No replicable framework
      severity: critical
    - id: P3_V03
      condition: passing_minds < 3
      action: ESCALATE - Human decision required
      severity: critical
    - id: P3_V04
      condition: tier_0_count == 0
      action: WARN - Missing diagnostic capability
      severity: warning
  phase_5:
    - id: P5_V01
      condition: final_count < 3 OR final_count > 5
      action: WARN - Final list should be 3-5 minds
      severity: warning
    - id: P5_V02
      condition: tier_0_count == 0
      action: ESCALATE - No Tier 0 mind in final list
      severity: critical
final_output:
  format: markdown
  template: |
    # Mind Research Report: {Domain}

    **Generated:** {date}
    **Domain:** {domain}
    **Context:** {context}
    **Iterations executed:** {3-5}

    ---

    ## Executive Summary
    {Paragraph summarizing research and conclusions}

    ---

    ## Final Elite: {N} Selected Minds

    ### Tier Distribution
    | Tier | Minds | Role |
    |------|-------|------|
    | Tier 0 | {names} | Diagnosis/Audit - ALWAYS first |
    | Tier 1 | {names} | Core Masters - Primary execution |
    | Tier 2 | {names} | Systematizers - Frameworks |
    | Tier 3 | {names} | Specialists - Format-specific |

    ---

    ### 1. {Expert Name}
    - **Tier:** {0|1|2|3}
    - **Known for:** {description}
    - **Main Framework:** {framework name}
    - **Why include:** {justification}
    - **Quality Score:** {X}/10
    - **Documentation Score:** {X}/15
    - **Available Material:**
      - {book/course/article 1}
      - {book/course/article 2}

    ...

    ---

    ## Minds Considered but Not Selected
    | Expert | Reason for Exclusion |

    ---

    ## Next Steps
    For each selected mind, execute:
    1. `wf-clone-mind.yaml` - Clone mind DNA
    2. `create-agent.md` - Create agent from DNA

    ---

    ## Research Metadata
    | Metric | Value |
    |--------|-------|
    | Initial names mapped | {N} |
    | After devil's advocate | {N} |
    | After framework validation | {N} |
    | Final elite | {N} |
    | Iterations executed | {N} |
execution_rules:
  always:
    - Execute MINIMUM 3 iterations
    - Question your own research in each iteration
    - Validate existence of DOCUMENTED FRAMEWORK
    - Justify each inclusion and exclusion
    - Seek diversity of approaches
  never:
    - Accept names without validating frameworks
    - Trust only memory/prior knowledge
    - Skip the devil's advocate iteration
    - Keep a name just because they're famous
    - Stop before 3 iterations
  absolute_cut_criterion: |
    "Is there sufficient documentation of this person's processes
    for an agent to replicate the method?"

    - YES → Continues
    - NO → Cut, no matter how famous they are
quality_guarantees:
  - Minimum 3 iterations MANDATORY
  - Maximum 5 iterations if necessary
  - Each iteration QUESTIONS the previous one
  - Only those with DOCUMENTED FRAMEWORKS pass
  - Tier distribution ensures diagnostic capability (Tier 0)
integration:
  executed_by:
    - squad-chief.md when user requests squad in new domain
  feeds_into:
    - workflow: wf-clone-mind.yaml
      context: List of minds to clone
    - task: create-agent.md
      context: Data for each mind
  complete_flow: |
    mind-research-loop (this)
        ↓
    [For each selected mind]
        ↓
    wf-clone-mind.yaml
        ↓
    create-agent.md
        ↓
    Complete squad with cloned minds
examples:
  - name: Copywriting Squad
    input:
      domain: copywriting
      context: for info-product sales
      must_include_local: false
    flow:
      iteration_1: 18 names mapped (Halbert, Ogilvy, Hopkins, etc.)
      iteration_2: 12 names after questioning (removed influencers without framework)
      iteration_3: 8 names with documented frameworks
      final: 6 elite minds (Halbert, Ogilvy, Schwartz, Kennedy, Bencivenga, Sugarman)
  - name: Brazilian Legal Squad
    input:
      domain: corporate and tax law
      context: for Brazilian startups
      must_include_local: true
      specific_needs:
        - contracts
        - tax
        - corporate
    flow:
      iteration_1: 15 names (global + Brazilian mix)
      iteration_2: 10 names (added lesser-known Brazilian specialists)
      iteration_3: 6 names with frameworks (cut theorists without methodology)
      final: 5 minds (3 Brazilian + 2 global with applicable frameworks)
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/wf-model-tier-qualification.yaml

````yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-model-tier-qualification
  name: Model Tier Qualification
  version: "2.2"
  purpose: Testar empiricamente se uma task pode rodar em modelo mais barato mantendo qualidade
  orchestrator: "@pedro-valerio"
  mode: autonomous
  description: Legacy phase-based workflow for model-tier qualification.
  type: qualification
  state_machine:
    states: [init, pre-flight, parallel-execution, compare-auto-decide, auto-improve-loop, generate-report, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: pre-flight
      - trigger: pre_flight_complete
        source: pre-flight
        dest: parallel-execution
      - trigger: pre_flight_failed
        source: pre-flight
        dest: failed
      - trigger: parallel_execution_complete
        source: parallel-execution
        dest: compare-auto-decide
      - trigger: parallel_execution_failed
        source: parallel-execution
        dest: failed
      - trigger: compare_auto_decide_qualified
        source: compare-auto-decide
        dest: generate-report
      - trigger: compare_auto_decide_needs_compensation
        source: compare-auto-decide
        dest: auto-improve-loop
      - trigger: compare_auto_decide_failed
        source: compare-auto-decide
        dest: failed
      - trigger: auto_improve_loop_complete
        source: auto-improve-loop
        dest: generate-report
      - trigger: auto_improve_loop_escalate
        source: auto-improve-loop
        dest: generate-report
      - trigger: auto_improve_loop_failed
        source: auto-improve-loop
        dest: failed
      - trigger: generate_report_complete
        source: generate-report
        dest: complete
      - trigger: generate_report_failed
        source: generate-report
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - step: phase-0
      id: phase-0
      phase: 1
      phase_name: PRE-FLIGHT
      agent: pedro-valerio
      action: execute_pre-flight
      task_ref: tasks/qualify-task.md
      next: phase-1
    - step: phase-1
      id: phase-1
      phase: 2
      phase_name: PARALLEL EXECUTION
      agent: pedro-valerio
      action: execute_parallel-execution
      task_ref: tasks/qualify-task.md
      next: phase-2
    - step: phase-2
      id: phase-2
      phase: 3
      phase_name: COMPARE & AUTO-DECIDE
      agent: pedro-valerio
      action: execute_compare-auto-decide
      task_ref: tasks/an-compare-outputs.md
      next: phase-3
    - step: phase-3
      id: phase-3
      phase: 4
      phase_name: AUTO-IMPROVE LOOP
      agent: pedro-valerio
      action: execute_auto-improve-loop
      task_ref: tasks/qualify-task.md
      next: phase-4
    - step: phase-4
      id: phase-4
      phase: 5
      phase_name: GENERATE REPORT
      agent: pedro-valerio
      action: execute_generate-report
      task_ref: tasks/qualify-task.md
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
philosophy:
  core: |
    "Não assumir. Provar com dados."
    "Prioridade é $$ economia, não token economia."
    "Se permitir caminho errado, está errado."
  decision_patterns:
    - id: DP_01
      name: Self-Contained First
      rule: Tudo dentro do squad-creator. Sem dependências externas.
    - id: DP_02
      name: Prove que Funciona
      rule: Validação empírica obrigatória. Documentação ≠ Funcionamento.
    - id: DP_03
      name: Questione o Caminho Errado
      rule: Se executor CONSEGUE errar → redesenhar.
    - id: DP_04
      name: Testar Antes de Escalar
      rule: Nunca batch sem validar 1 primeiro.
    - id: DP_05
      name: Cost-First
      rule: Haiku usando 3x mais tokens = OK se custa 15x menos em $$.
    - id: DP_06
      name: Mantenha Tudo Junto
      rule: Outputs, logs, reports → tudo em test-cases/{task_name}/.
    - id: DP_07
      name: Documente o Processo
      rule: O COMO é mais valioso que o resultado.
    - id: DP_08
      name: Auto-Improve
      rule: Se falhar, aplicar compensações e re-testar AUTOMATICAMENTE.
  cost_reference:
    haiku:
      input_per_mtok: 0.25
      output_per_mtok: 1.25
    sonnet:
      input_per_mtok: 3
      output_per_mtok: 15
    opus:
      input_per_mtok: 15
      output_per_mtok: 75
veto_conditions:
  - id: MTQ_VC_001
    trigger: Task sem test_input definido no registry
    action: BLOCK - Não testar. Adicionar input ao registry primeiro.
  - id: MTQ_VC_002
    trigger: Opus baseline output vazio ou erro
    action: BLOCK - Não prosseguir sem baseline válido.
  - id: MTQ_VC_003
    trigger: Haiku output não parseável (YAML inválido, estrutura quebrada)
    action: BLOCK - Falha de formato. Compensar com COMP_002 ou COMP_003.
  - id: MTQ_VC_004
    trigger: "Haiku decisão oposta ao Opus (ex: PASS vs FAIL)"
    action: BLOCK - Haiku NÃO qualificado. Decisão errada é inaceitável.
  - id: MTQ_VC_005
    trigger: Test case sem output salvo em arquivo
    action: BLOCK - Tudo deve ser verificável por humano.
  - id: MTQ_VC_006
    trigger: Mais de 2 rounds de compensação sem atingir threshold
    action: ESCALATE - Promover para Sonnet e testar.
test_input_registry:
  pv-axioma-assessment:
    target: squads/squad-creator-pro/workflows/wf-clone-mind.yaml

  pv-modernization-score:

  validate-squad:

  validate-extraction:
    target: .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/pedro_valerio/extraction-report.yaml

  qa-after-creation:
    target: squads/copy

  an-fidelity-score:

    type: mind_directory

  an-clone-review:

  an-validate-clone:

  an-assess-sources:

  refresh-registry:

  create-template:
````
