```yaml
      - trigger: approval_gate_rejected
        source: approval-gate
        dest: failed
      - trigger: foundation_convergence_complete
        source: foundation-convergence
        dest: material-triage
      - trigger: foundation_convergence_failed
        source: foundation-convergence
        dest: failed
      - trigger: material_triage_complete
        source: material-triage
        dest: executor-optimization
      - trigger: material_triage_failed
        source: material-triage
        dest: failed
      - trigger: executor_optimization_complete
        source: executor-optimization
        dest: runtime-smoke
      - trigger: executor_optimization_failed
        source: executor-optimization
        dest: failed
      - trigger: runtime_smoke_complete
        source: runtime-smoke
        dest: validate-self-heal
      - trigger: runtime_smoke_failed
        source: runtime-smoke
        dest: failed
      - trigger: validate_self_heal_complete
        source: validate-self-heal
        dest: economy-report
      - trigger: validate_self_heal_failed
        source: validate-self-heal
        dest: failed
      - trigger: economy_report_complete
        source: economy-report
        dest: finalization
      - trigger: economy_report_failed
        source: economy-report
        dest: failed
      - trigger: finalization_complete
        source: finalization
        dest: complete
      - trigger: finalization_failed
        source: finalization
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  description: |
    Canonical YOLO optimization workflow for squads that already passed initial
    governance review and now need autonomous hardening.

    This workflow exists for the real execution pattern that emerged in practice:
    1. preflight and baseline
    2. deep optimization scan
    3. one human approval gate
    4. autonomous execution until done
    5. validation, economy report, and optional git finalization
  type: optimization
  orchestrator: "@pedro-valerio"
  specialists:
    - "@pedro-valerio"
    - "@oalanicolas"
  mode: autonomous
  command: "*optimize-yolo {squad_name} [--focus all|tasks|checklists|templates|agents|workflows|data|materials] [--business {slug}] [--product {slug}] [--app {id}] [--context-type {type}] [--commit] [--push]"
  governance_protocol: squads/squad-creator/protocols/ai-first-governance.md
  philosophy:
    core: |
      "One approval gate. Then no more friction."

      "Do not optimize isolated files. Optimize the operating system:
      runtime, tasks, workflows, checklists, materials, and validation."
    principles:
      - id: OY_001
        name: Single Gate
        rule: One human approval after scan and plan. No repeated 'continue?' prompts after that.
      - id: OY_002
        name: Source of Truth First
        rule: Resolve source-of-truth drift before polishing outputs.
      - id: OY_003
        name: Convergence Over Cosmetics
        rule: Prioritize runtime, tasks, workflows, checklists, and materials alignment before low-signal cleanup.
      - id: OY_004
        name: Worker Where Deterministic
        rule: Move loading, extraction, scoring, and batch assembly to Worker/Hybrid whenever defensible.
      - id: OY_005
        name: Material Utility Triage
        rule: Every support document must be classified as active, integrate_next, or archive.
      - id: OY_006
        name: Student Safe by Default
        rule: Push is opt-in. Commit is opt-in. Validation is mandatory.
      - id: OY_007
        name: Mode Contract First
        rule: Resolve and report the canonical environment contract before any workspace-aware optimization path.
  inputs:
    required:
      - name: squad_name
        type: string
        description: Name of the squad to optimize
        example: copy
    optional:
      - name: focus
        type: enum
        values:
          - all
          - tasks
          - checklists
          - templates
          - agents
          - workflows
          - data
          - materials
        default: all
        description: Optimization focus area
      - name: commit
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: Create a commit after validation succeeds
      - name: push
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: Push after commit succeeds. Requires explicit preflight opt-in.
      - name: execution_mode
        type: enum
        values:
          - safe
          - full_yolo
        default: full_yolo
        description: full_yolo runs the full autonomous path after approval
      - name: business
        type: string
        description: Explicit business slug used when attempting full_workspace_mode
      - name: product
        type: string
        description: Explicit product slug used when attempting full_workspace_mode
      - name: app
        type: string
        description: Explicit app id used when attempting full_workspace_mode
      - name: context_type
        type: string
        description: Optional context type override forwarded to the shared environment detector
  approval_model:
    type: single_gate
    gate_id: approval_after_plan
    contract: |
      After the preflight report and optimization plan are presented, the user
      approves once. Once approved, the workflow continues autonomously until:
      - validation finishes
      - a critical veto fires
      - or an explicit opt-in action (commit/push) is completed
  veto_conditions:
    - id: OY_VC_001
      trigger: Squad does not exist or lacks config.yaml
      action: BLOCK — run validate-squad or fix path first.
    - id: OY_VC_002
      trigger: Quick validation baseline fails before optimization
      action: BLOCK — do not optimize a structurally failing squad.
    - id: OY_VC_003
      trigger: Attempted modification of voice_dna without explicit human approval
      action: BLOCK — flag for manual review only.
    - id: OY_VC_004
      trigger: Validation score drops by more than 0.5 after implementation
      action: BLOCK — rollback last wave or stop for review.
    - id: OY_VC_005
      trigger: Workflow contracts fail after implementation
      action: BLOCK — do not finalize broken workflow topology.
    - id: OY_VC_006
      trigger: Push requested without explicit preflight opt-in
      action: BLOCK — commit may proceed, push may not.
    - id: OY_VC_007
      trigger: Attempted use of enterprise-only surfaces without explicit enterprise proof in environment_contract
      action: BLOCK — fail closed to portable_docs_mode or stop for review.
  pre_flight:
    blocking: true
    purpose: Establish mode contract, risk, baseline, and one-shot approval contract
    steps:
      - id: pf_0_environment
        action: Resolve canonical environment contract
        command: "node squads/squad-creator/scripts/detect-environment-contract.cjs --squad={squad_name} [--business={business}] [--product={product}] [--app={app}] [--context-type={context_type}] --format=json"
        output: environment_contract
      - id: pf_1_repo_global_baseline
        action: Capture repo-global quality gate baseline
        command: "node infrastructure/scripts/squads/capture_repo_global_quality_baseline.cjs"
        output: repo_global_quality_baseline
      - id: pf_2_baseline
        action: Run quick validation baseline
        command: "bash squads/squad-creator/scripts/validate-squad.sh {squad_name} --quick --json"
        output: baseline_validation
      - id: pf_3_inventory
        action: Build artifact inventory
        command: "find squads/{squad_name} -type f"
        output: artifact_inventory
      - id: pf_4_git
        action: Capture git context
        command: "git status --short"
        output: git_context
      - id: pf_5_risk
        action: Classify execution risk
        output: risk_profile
        logic: |
          HIGH if:
          - dirty worktree on target files
          - many workflows/checklists touched
          - voice_dna present in likely edit scope
          MEDIUM otherwise
      - id: pf_6_plan_contract
        action: Present one-gate execution contract
        output: approval_contract
        message: |
          Preflight complete. Next step is deep scan + plan.
          After user approval, workflow runs autonomously until validation and
          economy reporting complete.
          Active mode contract, source of truth, and projection freshness must
          remain explicit in the final report. Repo-global blocker provenance
          must compare final gate failures against the captured preflight
          baseline instead of using ad hoc inference.
    approval_prompt:
      id: approval_after_plan
      question: |
        Approve full YOLO optimization after plan review?
        If yes, the workflow continues without additional confirmation prompts.
  sequence:
    - step: phase-0
      id: phase-0
      phase: 1
      phase_name: PREFLIGHT, MODE CONTRACT & BASELINE
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/optimize-scope-clarification.md
      action: execute_preflight_and_baseline
      outputs:
        - environment_contract
        - repo_global_quality_baseline
        - baseline_validation
        - artifact_inventory
        - risk_profile
      next: phase-1
    - step: phase-1
      id: phase-1
      phase: 2
      phase_name: DEEP SCAN
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/optimize-target-inventory.md
      action: execute_full_optimization_scan
      outputs:
        - optimization_findings
        - material_inventory
        - executor_map
        - convergence_gaps
      next: phase-2
    - step: phase-2
      id: phase-2
      phase: 3
      phase_name: PLAN
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/optimize-workflow-cost-projection.md
      action: execute_wave_plan_generation
      outputs:
        - optimization_plan
        - priority_matrix
        - approval_summary
      next: approval_after_plan
    - step: approval_after_plan
      id: approval_after_plan
      phase: 4
      phase_name: APPROVAL GATE
      agent: pedro-valerio
      action: request_single_human_approval
      blocking: true
      next: phase-3
    - step: phase-3
      id: phase-3
      phase: 5
      phase_name: FOUNDATION CONVERGENCE
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/optimize-gap-zero.md
      action: execute_foundation_convergence
      description: |
        Fix runtime/tasks/workflows/checklists source-of-truth drift first.
        This phase absorbs the most important systemic improvements before any
        broad cleanup wave.
      outputs:
        - runtime_hardening
        - workflow_checklist_alignment
      next: phase-4
    - step: phase-4
      id: phase-4
      phase: 6
      phase_name: MATERIAL TRIAGE & ACTIVATION
      agent: oalanicolas
      task_ref: tasks/optimize-workflow-phase-necessity.md
      action: execute_material_utility_pass
      description: |
        Inventory support materials, classify them as active/integrate/archive,
        activate high-value materials, and relocate low-value docs when
        necessary.
      outputs:
        - material_activation_report
        - archive_relocation_log
      next: phase-5
    - step: phase-5
      id: phase-5
      phase: 7
      phase_name: EXECUTOR OPTIMIZATION WAVES
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/optimize-hybrid-executor.md
      action: execute_worker_hybrid_conversion_waves
      description: |
        Apply `*optimize --hybrid` logic to the highest-ROI targets, especially:
        loading, extraction, scoring, rubric, and batch evaluation tasks.
      outputs:
        - worker_hybrid_changes
        - token_savings_projection
      next: phase-5b
    - step: phase-5b
      id: phase-5b
      phase: 8
      phase_name: RUNTIME SMOKE
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/optimize-empirical-validation.md
      action: execute_runtime_smoke_gate
      description: |
        Re-run the exact runtime-critical commands and executor surfaces
        introduced or modified by the optimization waves using representative
        arguments derived from explicit runtime context and the changed
        contract surfaces. Placeholder-only smoke inputs are invalid.
      outputs:
        - runtime_smoke_report
      next: phase-6
    - step: phase-6
      id: phase-6
      phase: 9
      phase_name: VALIDATE & SELF-HEAL
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/optimize-workflow-validate.md
      action: execute_validation_and_fix_loop
      description: |
        Run workflow contracts, quick/full validation, and fix non-critical
        findings automatically where safe.
      outputs:
        - validation_report
        - remaining_manual_flags
      next: phase-7
    - step: phase-7
      id: phase-7
      phase: 10
      phase_name: ECONOMY REPORT
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/optimize-post-economy.md
      action: execute_post_optimization_economy_analysis
      outputs:
        - economy_report
        - before_after_metrics
      next: phase-8
    - step: phase-8
      id: phase-8
      phase: 11
      phase_name: FINALIZATION
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/optimize-roi-report.md
      action: execute_finalize_commit_push_if_allowed
      outputs:
        - final_report
        - commit_sha
        - push_status
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  execution_rules:
    autonomous_after_gate: true
    continue_on_non_critical:
      - low_value_doc_relocation_warnings
      - legacy_reference_notes
      - optional_materials_missing
    must_stop_on:
      - any_veto_condition
      - validation_score_regression
      - workflow_contract_failures
      - unapproved_voice_dna_changes
  handoff_prompts:
    - from: "@pedro-valerio"
      to: "@oalanicolas"
      when: "After foundation convergence and before material triage"
      prompt: |
        Material utility pass only.
        Classify support artifacts as active, integrate_next, or archive.
        Activate high-value materials, preserve canonical naming, and avoid
        reopening already-closed governance decisions unless evidence forces it.
    - from: "@oalanicolas"
      to: "@pedro-valerio"
      when: "After material triage and before executor optimization waves"
      prompt: |
        Resume full-system optimization with the updated material inventory.
        Prioritize Worker/Hybrid conversions for deterministic loading,
        extraction, scoring, and batch evaluation surfaces. Keep core creative
        generation in Agent unless a deterministic sub-surface is explicit.
  phase_details:
    phase_1_deep_scan:
      required_analyses:
        - runtime_vs_task_vs_workflow consistency
        - checklist binding explicitness
        - material utility inventory
        - worker_vs_hybrid_vs_agent classification
        - source-of-truth matrix by stage
        - doc-drift vs actual counts and declared bridges
      required_outputs:
        - optimization-findings.md
        - optimization-plan.md
    phase_5_worker_hybrid:
      priority_order:
        - load-workspace-context
        - loading/runtime tasks
        - scoring/audit/rubric tasks
        - batch workflows
        - extraction/agent-creation support tasks
      never_auto_convert:
        - big-idea generation
        - mechanism design
        - sales page writing
        - email sequence writing
        - other core creative judgment tasks
    phase_8_runtime_smoke:
      trigger_when_changes_include:
        - workspace_integration
        - required_preflight
        - readiness_resolver
        - context_task
        - workflow.agent
        - workflow.executor
        - handoff_prompts
      representative_args:
        derive_from:
          - explicit runtime inputs: business, product, app, context_type
          - target squad canonical input names
          - changed command or executor surfaces
        forbid_placeholder_only: true
      fail_closed_on:
        - command_failure
        - unsupported_squad
        - missing_runtime_dependency
        - enterprise_surface_without_proof
    phase_8_finalize:
      commit_policy:
        default: disabled
        if_commit_true: create single logical commit
        if_push_true: push only when explicitly approved in preflight
  outputs:
    primary:
      - file: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-yolo-report-{date}.md"
        description: Final autonomous optimization report
      - file: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-yolo-plan-{date}.md"
        description: Approved execution plan
    supporting:
      - file: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-material-inventory-{date}.yaml"
      - file: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-economy-{date}.md"
      - file: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-validation-{date}.json"
      - file: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-repo-baseline-{date}.json"
        description: Preflight repo-global baseline used to classify final quality-gate provenance
      - file: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-runtime-smoke-{date}.json"
        description: Exact runtime-smoke command evidence, arguments, and failure classification
      - file: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-doc-drift-{date}.json"
        description: README/ARCHITECTURE/CHANGELOG drift report for counts and declared bridges
      - file: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-validation-fallback-{date}.json"
        description: Timeout or inconclusive validation fallback evidence
      - file: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-split-verdict-{date}.json"
        description: Machine-readable local/global verdict matrix and blocker provenance
      - file: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-environment-{date}.json"
        description: Machine-readable environment contract and projection freshness evidence
  runtime_smoke_contract:
    required: true
    trigger_when_changes_include:
      - workspace_integration
      - required_preflight
      - readiness_resolver
      - context_task
      - workflow.agent
      - workflow.executor
      - handoff_prompts
    representative_args:
      derive_from:
        - explicit runtime inputs: business, product, app, context_type
        - target squad canonical input names
        - changed command or executor surfaces
      forbid_placeholder_only: true
    block_on:
      - command_failure
      - unsupported_squad
      - missing_runtime_dependency
      - enterprise_surface_without_proof
    mode_rules:
      portable_docs_mode:
        evidence_source: docs_projection
        forbid_enterprise_only_surfaces: true
      full_workspace_mode:
        requires:
          - environment_contract.runtime_mode == full_workspace_mode
          - explicit business/product/app context
          - readiness_status == ready
  validation_contract:
    validate_squad:
      primary_command: "bash squads/squad-creator/scripts/validate-squad.sh {squad_name} --quick --json"
      timeout_seconds: 120
      on_timeout: inconclusive
      on_partial_output: inconclusive
      fallback_steps:
        - "node infrastructure/scripts/squads/validate_workflow_contracts.cjs --squads {squad_name} --json"
        - "node infrastructure/scripts/squads/validate_squad_runtime_ssot.cjs"
      evidence_artifact: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-validation-fallback-{date}.json"
    doc_drift_check:
      command: "node infrastructure/scripts/squads/check_doc_drift.cjs --squad {squad_name} --json"
      evidence_artifact: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-doc-drift-{date}.json"
    quality_gates:
      baseline_required: true
      baseline_output: repo_global_quality_baseline
      baseline_evidence_artifact: "{squad_path}/docs/optimization-repo-baseline-{date}.json"
      provenance_rule: "compare final quality-gate failures against repo_global_quality_baseline before assigning blocker_origin"
      required_before_success:
        - npm run lint
        - npm run typecheck
        - npm test
      blocker_origin_values:
        - introduced
        - pre-existing
        - unrelated
        - inconclusive
  reporting_contract:
    environment_contract:
      required: true
      fields:
        - access_tier
        - runtime_mode
        - source_of_truth
        - reason
        - evidence_paths
      projection_freshness_required_when: "source_of_truth == docs_projection"
      enterprise_fail_closed: true
    split_verdict:
      required_fields:
        - squad_local_status
        - repo_global_status
        - blocker_origin
        - blocking_surface
        - evidence_paths
        - repo_global_baseline_status
        - repo_global_baseline_evidence_paths
      blocker_origin_values:
        - introduced
        - pre-existing
        - unrelated
        - inconclusive
      preserve_local_green_when_repo_global_red_on:
        - pre-existing
        - unrelated
        - inconclusive
  command_examples:
    - "*optimize-yolo copy"
    - "*optimize-yolo brand --business aiox --context-type brand"
    - "*optimize-yolo copy --focus tasks"
    - "*optimize-yolo copy --commit"
    - "*optimize-yolo copy --commit --push"
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/wf-plan-squad.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-plan-squad
  name: Deep Squad Planning
  version: "1.3.0"
  purpose: >
    Create a deep, execution-ready PRD for a squad before running create-squad.
    This workflow exists for large or high-risk squads that need full planning
    visibility before implementation starts.
  state_machine:
    states: [init, preflight, depth-calibration, domain-mapping, architecture, challenge-reorder, roadmap, prd-assembly, handoff, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: preflight
      - trigger: preflight_complete
        source: preflight
        dest: depth-calibration
      - trigger: preflight_failed
        source: preflight
        dest: failed
      - trigger: depth_calibration_complete
        source: depth-calibration
        dest: domain-mapping
      - trigger: depth_calibration_failed
        source: depth-calibration
        dest: failed
      - trigger: domain_mapping_complete
        source: domain-mapping
        dest: architecture
      - trigger: domain_mapping_failed
        source: domain-mapping
        dest: failed
      - trigger: architecture_complete
        source: architecture
        dest: challenge-reorder
      - trigger: architecture_failed
        source: architecture
        dest: failed
      - trigger: challenge_reorder_complete
        source: challenge-reorder
        dest: roadmap
      - trigger: challenge_reorder_failed
        source: challenge-reorder
        dest: failed
      - trigger: roadmap_complete
        source: roadmap
        dest: prd-assembly
      - trigger: roadmap_failed
        source: roadmap
        dest: failed
      - trigger: prd_assembly_complete
        source: prd-assembly
        dest: handoff
      - trigger: prd_assembly_failed
        source: prd-assembly
        dest: failed
      - trigger: handoff_complete
        source: handoff
        dest: complete
      - trigger: handoff_failed
        source: handoff
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  description: |
    Pro-only planning workflow for squads that require a full product-level PRD
    before creation. Produces a deep planning document in
    docs/projects/{domain}/prd.md and a runtime planning summary.
  type: planning
  orchestrator: "@squad-chief"
  specialists:
    - "@pedro-valerio"
    - "@thiago_finch"
  mode: guided
  command: "*plan-squad {domain} [--purpose \"...\"] [--target-user \"...\"] [--reference {path}] [--output {path}] [--business {slug}] [--product {slug}] [--app {id}]"
  governance_protocol: squads/squad-creator/protocols/ai-first-governance.md
  distribution_constraint: pro_only
  inputs:
    required:
      - name: domain
        type: string
        description: Domain or squad problem space to plan
        example: editais
    optional:
      - name: purpose
        type: string
        description: High-level purpose of the squad
      - name: target_user
        type: string
        description: Primary user or operator of the squad
      - name: reference
        type: path
        description: Optional benchmark document used to calibrate depth
      - name: output
        type: path
        default: docs/projects/{domain}/prd.md
        description: Explicit PRD output path
      - name: business
        type: string
        description: Optional business slug for environment contract resolution
      - name: product
        type: string
        description: Optional product slug for environment contract resolution
      - name: app
        type: string
        description: Optional app id for environment contract resolution
  veto_conditions:
    - id: PS_VC_001
      trigger: Problem framing absent and no defensible evidence to infer it
      action: BLOCK - ask for problem framing before generating a deep PRD.
    - id: PS_VC_002
      trigger: Workflow/capability inventory skipped
      action: BLOCK - a deep PRD cannot be assembled without scope mapping.
    - id: PS_VC_003
      trigger: Reference document copied literally instead of adapted by pattern
      action: BLOCK - preserve depth, not domain-specific cargo culting.
    - id: PS_VC_004
      trigger: PRD assembled without roadmap, governance, or open questions
      action: BLOCK - document is not execution-ready.
    - id: PS_VC_005
      trigger: Architecture or roadmap approved without comparing defensible alternatives
      action: BLOCK - compare at least 2 options, record the rejected path, and justify the chosen order.
    - id: PS_VC_006
      trigger: Feedback changes assumptions, dependencies, or sequencing but the workflow patches the plan literally
      action: BLOCK - reopen architecture and challenge/reorder before continuing.
  outputs:
    - docs/projects/{domain}/prd.md
    - .aiox/squad-runtime/plan-squad/{domain}/planning-summary.yaml
  sequence:
    - step: phase-0
      id: phase-0
      phase: 1
      phase_name: PREFLIGHT
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/plan-squad.md
      action: resolve_planning_contract
      outputs:
        - planning_contract
        - environment_contract
      next: phase-1
    - step: phase-1
      id: phase-1
      phase: 2
      phase_name: DEPTH CALIBRATION
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/plan-squad.md
      action: calibrate_reference_depth
      outputs:
        - depth_rules
        - reference_delta
      next: phase-2
    - step: phase-2
      id: phase-2
      phase: 3
      phase_name: DOMAIN MAPPING
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/plan-squad.md
      action: map_capabilities_and_workflows
      outputs:
        - capability_map
        - workflow_inventory
        - risk_inputs
      next: phase-3
    - step: phase-3
      id: phase-3
      phase: 4
      phase_name: ARCHITECTURE
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/plan-squad.md
      action: design_agent_architecture_and_governance
      outputs:
        - agent_architecture
        - knowledge_model
        - governance_contract
      next: phase-4
    - step: phase-4
      id: phase-4
      phase: 5
      phase_name: CHALLENGE & REORDER
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/plan-squad.md
      action: stress_test_dependencies_and_reorder
      notes: Compare at least 2 sequencing options, identify premature items, blocked items, and not-before conditions. If user feedback reveals a hidden dependency or a flawed order, reopen the architecture instead of patching the roadmap literally.
      outputs:
        - challenge_report
        - alternatives_matrix
        - sequencing_rationale
      next: phase-5
    - step: phase-5
      id: phase-5
      phase: 6
      phase_name: ROADMAP
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/plan-squad.md
      action: define_epics_stories_and_quality_gates
      outputs:
        - roadmap
        - quality_gate_matrix
      next: phase-6
    - step: phase-6
      id: phase-6
      phase: 7
      phase_name: PRD ASSEMBLY
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/plan-squad.md
      action: assemble_prd_from_template
      outputs:
        - docs/projects/{domain}/prd.md
        - .aiox/squad-runtime/plan-squad/{domain}/planning-summary.yaml
      next: phase-7
    - step: phase-7
      id: phase-7
      phase: 8
      phase_name: HANDOFF
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/create-squad.md
      action: prepare_execution_handoff
      outputs:
        - execution_handoff
      next: complete
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  checkpoints:
    - id: CP_SCOPE
      phase: preflight
      decision: PROBLEM_AND_SCOPE_CLEAR
      blocking: true
    - id: CP_DEPTH
      phase: depth-calibration
      decision: DEPTH_CALIBRATED_WITHOUT_DOMAIN_LEAK
      blocking: true
    - id: CP_ARCH
      phase: architecture
      decision: ARCHITECTURE_AND_GOVERNANCE_COVERED
      blocking: true
    - id: CP_CHALLENGE
      phase: challenge-reorder
      decision: ORDER_AND_ALTERNATIVES_VALIDATED
      blocking: true
    - id: CP_PRD
      phase: prd-assembly
      decision: PRD_DEEP_ENOUGH_FOR_EXECUTION
      blocking: true
    - id: CP_HANDOFF
      phase: handoff
      decision: READY_FOR_PRE_EXISTING_BRIEF_FLOW
      blocking: true
  handoff:
    downstream_mode: pre_existing_brief
    next_command: "*create-squad {domain}"
    required_context:
      - docs/projects/{domain}/prd.md
      - .aiox/squad-runtime/plan-squad/{domain}/planning-summary.yaml
```

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-pv-audit
  name: Process Audit
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: >
    Audit squad/workflow for process failures using the "Impossibilitar Caminhos"
    framework. Three staged phases with progressive depth and explicit halts
    for user direction between phases.
  type: orchestration
  command: "*audit {squad_name} [--all]"
  state_machine:
    states: [init, overview, sample-analysis, deep-dive, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: overview
      - trigger: overview_complete
        source: overview
        dest: sample-analysis
      - trigger: overview_halt
        source: overview
        dest: complete
      - trigger: overview_failed
        source: overview
        dest: failed
      - trigger: sample_analysis_complete
        source: sample-analysis
        dest: deep-dive
      - trigger: sample_analysis_halt
        source: sample-analysis
        dest: complete
      - trigger: sample_analysis_failed
        source: sample-analysis
        dest: failed
      - trigger: deep_dive_complete
        source: deep-dive
        dest: complete
      - trigger: deep_dive_failed
        source: deep-dive
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - step: overview
      id: overview
      phase: 1
      phase_name: STRUCTURAL OVERVIEW
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/pv-audit-overview.md
      action: execute_structural_overview
      description: Structural overview without reading content (~2k tokens)
      inputs:
        - squad_name
      outputs:
        - squad_overview
      next: sample-analysis
    - step: sample-analysis
      id: sample-analysis
      phase: 2
      phase_name: SAMPLE ANALYSIS
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/pv-audit-sample.md
      action: execute_pattern_identification
      description: Pattern identification with representative sample (~5k tokens)
      inputs:
        - squad_overview
      outputs:
        - sample_analysis
        - red_flags
        - green_flags
      next: deep-dive
    - step: deep-dive
      id: deep-dive
      phase: 3
      phase_name: DEEP-DIVE
      agent: pedro-valerio
      task_ref: tasks/pv-audit-deep-dive.md
      action: execute_on_demand_deep_analysis
      description: On-demand analysis of specific agent/workflow/dna (~3k tokens)
      condition: user explicitly requests deep-dive
      inputs:
        - sample_analysis
        - target_artifact
      outputs:
        - deep_dive_report
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  veto_conditions:
    - id: VETO-PVA-001
      trigger: Audit exceeds 10k token budget
      action: BLOCK
    - id: VETO-PVA-002
      trigger: More than 3 files read per phase
      action: BLOCK
    - id: VETO-PVA-003
      trigger: Deep-dive without user direction
      action: BLOCK
  inputs:
    required:
      - name: squad_name
        type: string
        description: Squad name or workflow file path
    optional:
      - name: mode
        type: enum
        values: [sample, all]
        default: sample
        description: Sample audit or 100% audit in batches
  outputs:
    primary:
      - squad_overview
      - sample_analysis
      - deep_dive_report
```

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-refresh-registry
  name: Refresh Squad Registry
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: >
    Hybrid pipeline that scans all squads via Python script for deterministic counts
    and enriches entries with LLM for semantic metadata before writing the registry.
  type: orchestration
  command: "*refresh-registry"
  state_machine:
    states: [init, scan-collect, enrich-entries, write-validate, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: scan-collect
      - trigger: scan_collect_complete
        source: scan-collect
        dest: enrich-entries
      - trigger: scan_collect_failed
        source: scan-collect
        dest: failed
      - trigger: enrich_entries_complete
        source: enrich-entries
        dest: write-validate
      - trigger: enrich_entries_failed
        source: enrich-entries
        dest: failed
      - trigger: write_validate_complete
        source: write-validate
        dest: complete
      - trigger: write_validate_failed
        source: write-validate
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - step: scan-collect
      id: scan-collect
      phase: 1
      phase_name: SCAN & COLLECT
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/refresh-registry-scan.md
      action: execute_run_script_and_collect
      description: Run Python script to collect deterministic counts and metadata
      inputs:
        - squads_path
      outputs:
        - script_output
      next: enrich-entries
    - step: enrich-entries
      id: enrich-entries
      phase: 2
      phase_name: ENRICH ENTRIES
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/refresh-registry-enrich.md
      action: execute_llm_enrichment
      description: LLM enrichment to add domain, keywords, highlights, example_use
      inputs:
        - script_output
        - preserve_manual
      outputs:
        - enriched_entries
      next: write-validate
    - step: write-validate
      id: write-validate
      phase: 3
      phase_name: WRITE & VALIDATE
      agent: squad-chief
      task_ref: tasks/refresh-registry-write.md
      action: execute_write_domain_index_and_validate
      description: Build domain index, write registry file, validate output
      inputs:
        - enriched_entries
        - update_gaps
      outputs:
        - registry_file
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  inputs:
    optional:
      - name: squads_path
        type: string
        default: "squads/"
        description: Base path to scan
      - name: preserve_manual
        type: boolean
        default: true
        description: Keep manual highlights and quality_reference
      - name: update_gaps
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: Re-analyze gaps
  outputs:
    primary:
      - registry_file
```

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-research-then-create-agent
  name: Research Then Create Agent
  version: 2.2.0
  description: Contract adapter for legacy phase-based research-agent workflow.
  type: research
  state_machine:
    states: [init, parse-classify-input, check-local-knowledge, generate-research-prompt, execute-deep-research, validate-research-quality, extract-framework, create-agent-definition, quality-gate-validation, create-agent-tasks, complete, failed]
    transitions:

      - trigger: validate_research_quality_failed

      - trigger: quality_gate_failed
        source: quality-gate-validation
        dest: failed

        source: create-agent-tasks
        dest: complete
      - trigger: create_agent_tasks_failed
        source: create-agent-tasks
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - step: step-1
      id: step-1
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Parse & Classify Input
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_parse-input-parameters-and-classify-agent-type
      outputs:

    - step: step-2

workflow-id: wf-research-then-create-agent
name: Research Then Create Agent
version: 2.2.0
estimated-time: 30-60 minutes
complexity: high
description: |
  Create high-quality agents based on deep research about domain best practices,
  not generic LLM knowledge.

  Key insight: Agents created without research are weak and generic.

  This workflow ensures agents are built on REAL frameworks and methodologies
  from domain experts. All claims are traceable to sources.

  Quality Standard: AIOX Level (800+ lines, full semantic depth)
orchestrator: "@squad-chief"
mode: YOLO
quality_standards:
  agent_minimum_lines: 800
  task_minimum_lines: 600
  research_minimum_lines: 500
  primary_sources_minimum: 3
  required_agent_sections:
    - Identity (agent, persona, metadata)
    - Operational (frameworks, commands)
    - Voice DNA (starters, metaphors, vocabulary, states)
    - Quality (examples, anti-patterns, completion)
    - Credibility (if applicable)
    - Integration (handoffs, synergies)
frameworks:
  - id: tier-system-framework
    file: data/tier-system-framework.md
    usage: Agent tier classification (Step 1, 7)
  - id: quality-dimensions-framework
    file: data/quality-dimensions-framework.md
    usage: Research & output validation (Step 5, 8)
  - id: decision-heuristics-framework
    file: data/decision-heuristics-framework.md
    usage: Checkpoint logic (Step 5, 8)
  - id: executor-matrix-framework
    file: data/executor-matrix-framework.md
    usage: Task executor assignment during delegated task creation
inputs:
  - name: agent_purpose
    type: string
    required: true
    description: What the agent should do
    examples:
      - Create sales pages
      - Audit copy for persuasion
  - name: domain
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Domain/area of expertise
    examples:
      - copywriting
      - sales
      - marketing
  - name: specialist_slug
    type: string
    required: false
    description: If based on human expert (kebab-case)
    examples:
      - gary-halbert
      - david-ogilvy
  - name: specialist_name
    type: string
    required: false
    description: Human-readable name of specialist
    examples:
      - Gary Halbert
      - David Ogilvy
  - name: squad_name
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Target squad name
    examples:
      - copy
      - sales
  - name: output_dir
    type: path
    required: false
    default: docs/research/
    description: Research output directory
outputs:
  research:
    - name: research_document
      path: docs/research/{specialist_slug}-{topic}-research.md
      description: Comprehensive research document with citations
  agent:
    - name: agent_definition
      path: squads/{squad_name}/agents/{agent_id}.md
      description: Complete agent definition (800+ lines)
  tasks:
    - name: agent_tasks
      path: squads/{squad_name}/tasks/{task_id}.md
      description: Agent tasks based on framework (600+ lines each)
preconditions:
  - Squad exists at squads/{squad_name}/
  - "If specialist: check if mind exists in .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/{specialist_slug}/"
  - WebSearch tool available (for external research)
  - Write permissions for output directories
phases:
  - id: STEP-1
    name: Parse & Classify Input
    tier: 0
    duration: < 30 seconds
    description: |
      Parse input parameters and classify agent type.
      Determine if specialist-based or generic.
    actions:
      - Extract agent_purpose, domain, specialist info
      - Classify agent type (generic vs specialist_based)
      - Validate squad_name exists
      - Set output paths
    decision_point:
      if_specialist_slug: GOTO Step 2 (Check Local Knowledge)
      else: GOTO Step 3 (Generate Research Prompt)
    tier_classification:
      apply_framework: tier-system-framework
      logic: |
        - IF agent performs diagnosis/analysis FIRST → Tier 0
        - ELSE IF agent is primary expert with track record → Tier 1
        - ELSE IF agent creates frameworks/systems → Tier 2
        - ELSE IF agent specializes in specific format → Tier 3
        - ELSE IF agent is validation/checklist tool → Tools
      preliminary_tier: Estimate based on agent_purpose
      final_tier: Confirmed in Step 7 after research
    output:
      classification:
        agent_type: specialist_based | generic
        agent_purpose: string
        domain: string
        specialist:
          slug: string
          name: string
        squad_name: string
        research_output: path
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Input parsed successfully
        - Agent type classified
        - Output paths set
      human_review: false
  - id: STEP-2
    name: Check Local Knowledge
    tier: 0
    duration: 1-2 minutes
    condition: Only if agent_type == specialist_based
    description: |
      Search for existing local knowledge about the specialist.
      Catalog what we already have vs what we need.
    search_locations:
      primary_sources:
        path: .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/{specialist_slug}/sources/
        description: Raw materials, transcripts, books, articles
        priority: 1
      analysis:
        path: .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/{specialist_slug}/analysis/
        description: Identity core, cognitive spec, frameworks
        priority: 2
      existing_research:
        path: docs/research/{specialist_slug}-*.md
        description: Previous deep research documents
        priority: 3
      synthesis:
        path: .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/{specialist_slug}/synthesis/
        description: Communication style, mental models
        priority: 4
    output:
      local_knowledge_catalog:
        found_sources: array of files with metadata
        found_research: array of research files
        total_local_lines: number
        coverage_assessment: string
        gaps_identified: array
    output_example: |
      📂 Local Knowledge Check for 'gary_halbert':

      Found Resources:
        ✅ .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/gary_halbert/sources/ (12 files, 4,200 lines)
        ✅ .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/gary_halbert/analysis/identity-core.yaml
        ✅ docs/research/gary-halbert-direct-mail-research.md (890 lines)

      Coverage: 70% (strong foundation)
      Gaps: Sales page specific structure, digital adaptation

      → Research prompt will focus on GAPS only
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Local knowledge catalogued
        - Gaps identified
      human_review: false
  - id: STEP-3
    name: Generate Research Prompt
    tier: 1
    duration: 1-2 minutes
    description: |
      Generate a structured research prompt based on inputs
      and local knowledge gaps.
    reference: templates/research-prompt-tmpl.md
    prompt_components:
      - "REFINED_TOPIC: Strategic title expanding scope"
      - "CONTEXT: Purpose and practical objectives"
      - "SCOPE: 4-6 specific angles to investigate"
      - "REQUIREMENTS: 3-4 parameters for research"
      - "RECOMMENDED_SOURCES: 3-4 specific source types"
      - "EXPECTED_RESULTS: 3-5 concrete deliverables"
      - "CLARIFYING_QUESTIONS: 2-3 questions to refine"
    adaptation_logic:
      if_local_lines_gt_1000:
        prompt_mode: complementary
        prompt_focus: gaps_identified
        prompt_note: Already have {lines} of material. Focus on GAPS.
      else:
        prompt_mode: comprehensive
        prompt_focus: full_framework
        prompt_note: No existing material. Conduct comprehensive research.
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Research prompt generated with all 7 components
        - Prompt adapted based on local knowledge
      human_review: false
  - id: STEP-4
    name: Execute Deep Research
    tier: 1
    duration: 5-15 minutes
    description: |
      Execute deep research combining local knowledge and web search.
      Autonomous execution in YOLO mode.
    execution_phases:
      phase_1_local:
        condition: IF local_knowledge.total_lines > 0
        actions:
          - Read all found local files
          - Extract relevant sections for agent purpose
          - Create local_synthesis.md with key insights
          - Mark what's already covered
        output: Local knowledge synthesized
      phase_2_web:
        method: WebSearch + WebFetch
        queries:
          - "{specialist_name} {topic} methodology"
          - "{specialist_name} {topic} framework process"
          - "{specialist_name} {topic} examples case studies"
          - "{topic} best practices {domain}"
          - "{specialist_name} quotes rules principles"
        for_each_query:
          - Execute WebSearch
          - "For top 5-10 results: WebFetch content"
          - Extract relevant sections
          - Note source URL
          - Compile findings
        output: Web research compiled
      phase_3_consolidate:
        actions:
          - Merge local_synthesis + web_findings
          - Remove duplicates
          - Organize by research prompt sections
          - Add source citations throughout
          - Format as comprehensive research document
        output: docs/research/{specialist_slug}-{topic}-research.md
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Research document created
        - Contains local + web sources
        - Citations included
      human_review: false
  - id: STEP-5
    name: Validate Research Quality
    tier: 2
    duration: 1-2 minutes
    gate_type: BLOCKING
    description: |
      Validate research quality before proceeding.
      Apply quality dimensions and decision heuristics.
    frameworks_applied:
      - quality-dimensions-framework.md
      - decision-heuristics-framework.md
    quality_dimensions:
      accuracy:
        weight: 1
        threshold: 7
        veto_power: true
        check: Are claims verified by primary sources?
      coherence:
        weight: 0.9
        threshold: 6
        check: Is research internally consistent?
      strategic_alignment:
        weight: 0.9
        threshold: 6
        check: Does research cover what we need for agent?
      operational_excellence:
        weight: 0.8
        threshold: 6
        check: Are processes actionable, not just theory?
    heuristic:
      id: SC_RES_001
      name: Research Quality Gate
      from_framework: decision-heuristics-framework
      weights:
        primary_evidence: 0.9
        scope_coverage: 0.8
        actionability: 0.8
        source_credibility: 0.7
      thresholds:
        total_lines: 500
        primary_sources: 3
        scope_coverage: 4 of 6 sections
      veto_conditions:
        - condition: total_lines < 500
          action: VETO - Retry research with broader queries
        - condition: primary_sources < 2
          action: VETO - Insufficient primary evidence
      decision_tree: |
        IF total_lines < 500 → VETO (retry max 2x)
        ELSE IF primary_sources < 3 → REVIEW (flag, continue)
        ELSE IF quality_score >= 80% → APPROVE
        ELSE → REVIEW (continue with warning)
    validation_criteria:
      minimum_requirements:
        total_lines: 500
        primary_sources: 3
        sections_covered: 4
        actionable_frameworks: 1
      quality_checks:
        - check: Has primary evidence (quotes, examples)
          weight: 30%
        - check: Covers scope sections adequately
          weight: 25%
        - check: Contains actionable processes
          weight: 25%
        - check: Sources are credible and cited
          weight: 20%
      scoring:
        pass: ">= 80%"
        conditional: 60-79%
        fail: < 60%
    decision_logic:
      if_lines_lt_500:
        status: FAIL
        action: Retry research with broader queries
        max_retries: 2
      elif_primary_sources_lt_3:
        status: CONDITIONAL
        action: Flag for manual enrichment, continue
      elif_quality_gte_80:
        status: PASS
        action: Continue to Step 6
      else:
        status: CONDITIONAL
        action: Continue with warning, document gaps
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Research meets minimum line count
        - Quality score calculated
        - Pass/Fail determined
      human_review: false
  - id: STEP-6
    name: Extract Framework from Research
    tier: 2
    duration: 3-5 minutes
    description: |
      Extract actionable framework components from research.
      Transform raw research into structured agent inputs.
    extraction_components:
      principles:
        instruction: Extract explicit rules/principles stated by the expert
        format: Bullet list with source citation
      process:
        instruction: Extract step-by-step process the expert uses
        format: Numbered workflow
      structure:
        instruction: Extract structural anatomy of the output
        format: Template with sections
      quality_criteria:
        instruction: Extract what expert considers good vs bad
        format: Do/Don't list
      checklist:
        instruction: Derive validation checklist from expert criteria
        format: Checkbox list
    output:
      extracted_framework:
        name: string
        source: path
        principles: array
        process: array (numbered steps)
        structure: array (sections with purpose)
        quality_criteria:
          excellent: array
          weak: array
        checklist: array
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Framework extracted with all components
        - Each component has source citations
      human_review: false
  - id: STEP-7
    name: Create Agent Definition
    tier: 2
    duration: 3-5 minutes
    description: |
      Create agent definition using extracted framework.
      Must include all 6 levels per AIOX standard.
    dependency: tasks/create-agent.md
    framework: tier-system-framework.md
    tier_confirmation:
      tier_0_indicators:
        - Agent performs diagnosis BEFORE others act
        - Establishes baseline understanding
        - Analytical/audit focus
      tier_1_indicators:
        - Agent is primary expert for deliverables
        - Has documented track record
        - Creates main outputs
      tier_2_indicators:
        - Agent creates replicable frameworks
        - Systematizes processes
        - Teaching/methodology focus
      tier_3_indicators:
        - Agent specializes in specific format
        - Channel-specific optimization
        - Applied after core content exists
    auto_fill_from_framework:
      persona:
        role: Derived from specialist expertise
        style: Derived from specialist's known style
        identity: Based on {specialist_name}'s methodology
        focus: Derived from principles
      core_principles: Direct from extracted_framework.principles
      knowledge_areas: Derived from research scope
      capabilities: Derived from research expected_results
    required_levels:
      - "Level 1: Identity (agent, persona, metadata)"
      - "Level 2: Operational (frameworks, commands)"
      - "Level 3: Voice DNA (starters, metaphors, vocabulary, states)"
      - "Level 4: Quality (examples, anti-patterns, completion)"
      - "Level 5: Credibility (if applicable)"
      - "Level 6: Integration (handoffs, synergies)"
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - Agent definition created
        - All 6 levels present
        - Tier assigned
      human_review: false
  - id: STEP-8
    name: Quality Gate (Agent Validation)
    tier: 3
    duration: 1-2 minutes
    gate_type: BLOCKING
    description: |
      Validate agent against quality gate.
      Must pass all blocking requirements.
    frameworks_applied:
      - quality-dimensions-framework.md
      - decision-heuristics-framework.md
    quality_dimensions:
      accuracy:
        weight: 1
        threshold: 7
        veto_power: true
        check: Is agent based on verified research, not invented?
      coherence:
        weight: 0.9
        threshold: 6
        check: Is agent internally consistent?
      operational_excellence:
        weight: 0.8
        threshold: 6
        check: Are commands and workflows well-defined?
      scoring:
        method: weighted_average
        pass_threshold: 7
        per_dimension_min: 6
    heuristic:
      id: SC_AGT_001
      name: Agent Quality Gate
      from_framework: decision-heuristics-framework
      blocking_requirements:
        - check: agent_lines >= 800
          fail_action: Loop to Step 7 - add more detail
        - check: vocabulary.always_use.length >= 5
          fail_action: Add vocabulary from research
        - check: vocabulary.never_use.length >= 3
          fail_action: Add anti-patterns from research
        - check: output_examples.length >= 3
          fail_action: Add real examples from research
        - check: anti_patterns.never_do.length >= 5
          fail_action: Extract warnings from expert
        - check: completion_criteria defined
          fail_action: Define when agent task is done
        - check: handoff_to defined
          fail_action: Define handoffs to other agents
      decision_tree: |
        FOR each blocking_requirement:
          IF check FAILS → Log specific fix needed

        IF any FAIL → VETO (loop to Step 7 with fixes)
        ELSE → APPROVE (proceed to Step 9)
    checklist: checklists/agent-quality-gate.md
    on_fail:
      action: Loop back to Step 7
      provide: Specific fixes needed
      max_loops: 2
    on_pass:
      action: Continue to Step 9
      log: Quality Gate PASSED
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - All blocking requirements pass
        - Quality score >= 7.0
      human_review: false
  - id: STEP-9
    name: Create Agent Tasks
    tier: 3
    duration: 10-20 minutes per task
    description: |
      Create tasks for the agent based on extracted framework.
      Each task must be 600+ lines with primary evidence.
    framework: executor-matrix-framework.md
    executor_assignment:
      decision_tree:
        - IF step requires creativity/judgment → Human or Hybrid
        - IF step requires data analysis → Agent
        - IF step is deterministic/API → Worker
      common_patterns:
        research_step:
          executor: Agent
          rationale: Pattern recognition, data gathering
        creative_step:
          executor: Human
          rationale: Requires originality and judgment
        review_step:
          executor: Hybrid
          rationale: AI drafts, human validates
        automation_step:
          executor: Worker
          rationale: Deterministic, repeatable
    task_identification:
      source: agent_definition.capabilities
      example_tasks:
        - create-sales-page → Main task
        - analyze-sales-page → Audit task
        - optimize-headline → Support task
    task_structure:
      - purpose: From capability description
      - methodology: From extracted_framework.process
      - steps: Detailed from research
      - quality_gates: From extracted_framework.checklist
      - examples: From research primary sources
      - templates: Derived from extracted_framework.structure
    requirements:
      min_lines: 600
      must_include:
        - Methodology source citation
        - Step-by-step process from expert
        - Real examples analyzed
        - Quality checklist derived from expert
        - Anti-patterns from expert
      must_not:
        - Generic steps not from research
        - Invented examples
        - Vague instructions
    checkpoint:
      criteria:
        - All tasks created with 600+ lines
        - Each task based on extracted framework
        - Executor assigned to each task step
      human_review: true
      message: Review created tasks for completeness
final_output:
  template: |
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    ✅ WORKFLOW COMPLETED: Research Then Create Agent
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    📊 Summary:

    🔬 Research Phase:
       • Research document: {research_path}
       • Total lines: {lines}
       • Sources: {local_pct}% local + {web_pct}% web
       • Quality score: {score}% {status}

    🧬 Framework Extraction:
       • Principles extracted: {N}
       • Process steps: {N}
       • Structure sections: {N}
       • Quality criteria: {N}

    🤖 Agent Created:
       • ID: {agent_id}
       • Path: {agent_path}
       • Methodology: {specialist_name}
       • Based on: Primary research, not generic LLM

    📝 Tasks Created:
       • {task_1} ({lines} lines)
       • {task_2} ({lines} lines)
       • Total: {total_lines} lines of research-backed tasks

    📂 Files Generated:
       1. {research_path}
       2. {agent_path}
       3. {task_paths}

    ✅ Quality Guarantee:
       • All content traceable to primary sources
       • No generic LLM-invented methodology
       • Tasks exceed 600-line minimum
       • Agent ready for activation: @{agent_id}

    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
error_handling:
  research_failures:
    - error: No local knowledge found
      cause: Mind doesn't exist
      resolution: Continue with web-only research
    - error: WebSearch rate limit
      cause: Too many queries
      resolution: Backoff and retry
    - error: < 500 lines after research
      cause: Insufficient sources
      resolution: Retry with broader queries (max 2)
    - error: No primary sources
      cause: Only secondary content
      resolution: Flag warning, continue
  validation_failures:
    - error: Research too thin
      cause: Niche topic
      resolution: Accept CONDITIONAL, document gaps
    - error: No actionable framework
      cause: Theory-only sources
      resolution: Retry with 'process' 'how-to' queries
    - error: Quality < 60%
      cause: Poor research
      resolution: STOP, return to user
  agent_creation_failures:
    - error: Agent ID exists
      cause: Duplicate
      resolution: Prompt for new name or update existing
    - error: Task < 600 lines
      cause: Insufficient research
      resolution: Add more detail from sources
quality_guarantees:
  - No agent created without research foundation
  - All claims traceable to sources
  - Tasks based on REAL processes, not invented ones
  - All agents have voice_dna, output_examples, anti_patterns
  - All agents have completion_criteria and handoffs
  - Minimum 800 lines enforced by Quality Gate
anti_pattern_prevented: |
  ❌ OLD WAY (Problem):
     User: "Create copywriter agent"
     LLM: *invents generic copywriting advice*
     Result: Weak, generic agent

  ✅ NEW WAY (This workflow):
     User: "Create copywriter agent based on Gary Halbert"
     Workflow: *researches Halbert's REAL methodology*
     Result: Agent with authentic, traceable expertise
integration:
  upstream:
    - User request for new agent
    - Existing minds in .aiox/squad-runtime/minds/
    - Existing research in docs/research/
  downstream:
    - task: create-agent.md
      step: Quality-gated agent definition
    - task: create-task.md
      step: Delegated wrapper to base wf-create-task
    - system: Agent activation system
  lateral_planned:
    - upgrade-agent-with-research - For existing weak agents
    - bulk-research-agents - Multiple agents at once
examples:
  - name: Specialist-Based Agent
    command: |
      @squad-chief
      *workflow research-then-create-agent \
        --agent-purpose "Create high-converting sales pages" \
        --domain "copywriting" \
        --specialist-slug "gary-halbert" \
        --specialist-name "Gary Halbert" \
        --squad-name "copy"
  - name: Generic Domain Agent
    command: |
      @squad-chief
      *workflow research-then-create-agent \
        --agent-purpose "Conduct user interviews for product discovery" \
        --domain "product-management" \
        --squad-name "product"
  - name: Multiple Specialists (Blended)
    command: |
      @squad-chief
      *workflow research-then-create-agent \
        --agent-purpose "Create VSL scripts" \
        --domain "copywriting" \
        --specialist-slug "jon-benson" \
        --specialist-name "Jon Benson" \
        --secondary-specialists "eugene-schwartz,gary-halbert" \
        --squad-name "copy"
related_resources:
  tasks:
    - tasks/deep-research-pre-agent.md
    - tasks/create-agent.md
    - tasks/create-task.md
  templates:
    - templates/research-prompt-tmpl.md
    - templates/agent-tmpl.md
  checklists:
    - checklists/agent-quality-gate.md
```

```yaml
workflow:
  id: wf-smoke-test-model-routing
  name: Smoke Test Model Routing Pipeline
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: Canonical atomic pipeline for preflight, lookup, explicit execution, comparison, and reporting of model routing behavior.
  type: validation
  state_machine:
    states: [init, preflight, lookup, execution, comparison, report, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: preflight
      - trigger: preflight_complete
        source: preflight
        dest: lookup
      - trigger: preflight_failed
        source: preflight
        dest: failed
      - trigger: lookup_complete
        source: lookup
        dest: execution
      - trigger: lookup_failed
        source: lookup
        dest: failed
      - trigger: execution_complete
        source: execution
        dest: comparison
      - trigger: execution_failed
        source: execution
        dest: failed
      - trigger: comparison_complete
        source: comparison
        dest: report
      - trigger: comparison_failed
        source: comparison
        dest: failed
      - trigger: report_complete
        source: report
        dest: complete
      - trigger: report_failed
        source: report
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - step: preflight
      id: preflight
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Preflight
      agent: "@pedro-valerio"
      action: execute_preflight
      task_ref: smoke-test-model-routing-preflight
      next: lookup
    - step: lookup
      id: lookup
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Lookup Validation
      agent: "@pedro-valerio"
      action: execute_lookup_validation
      task_ref: smoke-test-model-routing-lookup
      next: execution
    - step: execution
      id: execution
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Explicit Model Execution
      agent: "@pedro-valerio"
      action: execute_explicit_model_test
      task_ref: smoke-test-model-routing-execution
      next: comparison
    - step: comparison
      id: comparison
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Comparison
      agent: "@pedro-valerio"
      action: execute_default_vs_explicit_comparison
      task_ref: smoke-test-model-routing-comparison
      next: report
    - step: report
      id: report
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Report
      agent: "@pedro-valerio"
      action: execute_smoke_report
      task_ref: smoke-test-model-routing-report
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  quality_gates:
    - id: SCP_SMR_001
      phase: report
      type: automated
      placement: exit
      severity: blocking
      description: Smoke test must produce a final report with recommendation.
      criteria:
        - field: smoke_test_report
          operator: "!="
          value: null
        - field: recommendation
          operator: "!="
          value: null
      on_fail: block
```

````yaml
    agent_decision_points:

        reason: Comparar função real de agents com nomes diferentes
      - id: quality_comparison

      - id: create_golden_records

  patterns_applied:

    - Expand-Contract (Database)
    - ETL Quality Gates
    - Strangler Fig (Microservices)
    - Due Diligence (M&A)
    - Entity Resolution (Deduplication)
    - CDC Event Logging
  description: |
    Workflow para fusão de múltiplos squads em um único squad consolidado.
    Segue o princípio "Dragon Ball Fusion" - combina o melhor de cada fonte.

    GARANTIAS:
    - Zero perda de componentes (auditado)
    - Zero duplicatas não-intencionais
    - 100% rastreabilidade (provenance)
    - Rollback possível até Phase 6
  type: orchestration
  state_machine:
    states: [init, initialization, discovery, deduplication, scope-filtering, collection, validation, structure-creation, integration-test, command-sync, cleanup, complete, failed]
    transitions:
      - trigger: start
        source: init
        dest: initialization
      - trigger: initialization_complete
        source: initialization
        dest: discovery
      - trigger: initialization_failed
        source: initialization
        dest: failed
      - trigger: discovery_complete
        source: discovery
        dest: deduplication
      - trigger: discovery_failed
        source: discovery
        dest: failed
      - trigger: deduplication_complete
        source: deduplication
        dest: scope-filtering
      - trigger: deduplication_failed
        source: deduplication
        dest: failed
      - trigger: scope_filtering_complete
        source: scope-filtering
        dest: collection
      - trigger: scope_filtering_failed
        source: scope-filtering
        dest: failed
      - trigger: collection_complete
        source: collection
        dest: validation
      - trigger: collection_failed
        source: collection
        dest: failed
      - trigger: validation_complete
        source: validation
        dest: structure-creation
      - trigger: validation_failed
        source: validation
        dest: failed
      - trigger: structure_creation_complete
        source: structure-creation
        dest: integration-test
      - trigger: structure_creation_failed
        source: structure-creation
        dest: failed
      - trigger: integration_test_complete
        source: integration-test
        dest: command-sync
      - trigger: integration_test_failed
        source: integration-test
        dest: failed
      - trigger: command_sync_complete
        source: command-sync
        dest: cleanup
      - trigger: command_sync_failed
        source: command-sync
        dest: failed
      - trigger: cleanup_complete
        source: cleanup
        dest: complete
      - trigger: cleanup_failed
        source: cleanup
        dest: failed
      - trigger: fail
        source: "*"
        dest: failed
  sequence:
    - step: phase-0-init
      id: phase-0-init
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Initialization
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_setup-workspace-e-valida-o-inicial
      task_ref: tasks/squad-fusion-initialize.md
      outputs:
        - workspace_path
        - backup_path
        - fusion_id
        - audit_log_path
      next: phase-1-discovery
    - step: phase-1-discovery
      id: phase-1-discovery
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Discovery (Due Diligence)
      agent: aiox-master

      next: phase-2-deduplication
    - step: phase-2-deduplication
      id: phase-2-deduplication
      phase: 3

      agent: aiox-master

      task_ref: tasks/squad-fusion-deduplication.md

    - step: phase-3-scope

      phase: 4
      phase_name: Scope Filtering
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_filtrar-componentes-fora-do-dom-nio-target

        - final_components

      next: phase-4-collection
    - step: phase-4-collection

      phase: 5
      phase_name: Collection (ETL Extract)
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_copiar-componentes-selecionados-para-workspace
      task_ref: tasks/squad-fusion-collection.md
      outputs:
        - workspace_contents
        - conflicts_resolved
        - provenance_map
      next: phase-5-validation
    - step: phase-5-validation
      id: phase-5-validation
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Validation (Quality Gates)
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_validar-integridade-antes-de-criar-estrutura-final

      outputs:

    - step: phase-6-structure

      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_criar-estrutura-final-do-squad-fusionado
      task_ref: tasks/squad-fusion-structure.md

        - squad_path

    - step: phase-7-integration

    - step: phase-7-5-command-sync
      id: phase-7-5-command-sync
      phase: 9
      phase_name: Command Sync (IDE Integration)
      agent: aiox-master
      action: execute_sincronizar-commands-para

      task_ref: tasks/squad-fusion-cleanup.md

    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
````
